verses.text: U Adam, u Seth, u Enosh,
u Kenan, u Mahalalel, u Jared,
u Enokh, u Methusela, u Lamek,
u Noa, u Shem, u Ham bad u Japheth.
Ki khun u Japheth kine: u Gomer, u Magog, u Madai, u Javan, u Tubal, u Meshekh, bad u Tiras.
Ki khun u Gomer kine: u Ashkenas, u Diphath, bad u Tokarma.
Ki khun u Jaban kine: U Elisha, u Tarshish, u Kittim bad u Rodanim.
Ki khun u Ham kine: u Kush, u Ijipt, u Put bad u Kanaan.
Ki khun u Kush: u Seba, u Habila, u Sabta, u Raama, bad u Sabteka. Ki khun u Raama: u Sheba bad u Dedan.
U Kush u la long u kpa jong u Nimrod, u ’riewkhrawbor u banyngkong ha pyrthei.
U Ijipt u la long u kpa jong u Ludim, u Anamim, u Lehabim, u Napthtuhim,
u Pathrusim, u Kasluhim (u kpa tymmen ki Philistia), bad u Kaphtorim.
U Kanaan u la long u kpa jong u Sidon, u khun phrangsngi bad u Heth,
nangta jong ki Jebus, ki Amor, ki Girgash,
jong ki Hib, ki Ark, ki Sin,
jong ki Arbad, ki Zemar bad ki Hamath.
Ki khun u Shem kine: u Elam, u Asshur, u Arpakhshad, u Lud, u Aram, u Us, u Hul, u Gether, bad u Meshekh.
U Arpakhshad u la long u kpa jong u Shela; bad u Shela u la long u kpa jong u Eber.
U Eber u la kha ar ngut ki khun. Ka kyrteng jong uwei ka la long u Pelek (ha ka por jong u la ïa sam bynta ïa ka khyndew), bad ka kyrteng u para jong u u Joktan.
U Joktan u la long u kpa jong u Almodad, u Shelep, u Hazarmaveth, u Jera,
u Hadoram, u Usal, u Dikla,
u Ebal, u Abimael, u Sheba,
u Ophir, u Habila, bad u Jobab. Kine baroh ki la long ki khun u Joktan.
U Shem, u Arpakhshad, u Shela;
u Eber, u Pelek, u Reu;
u Seruk, u Nahor, u Tera;
u Abram, kata ka mut, u Abraham.
Ki khun u Abraham kine: u Isaak bad u Ishmael.
Kine ki jinghiar pateng jong ki: u Nebaïoth u dei u khun phrangsngi u Ishmael; nangta bud u Kedar, u Adbeel, u Mibsam,
u Mishma, u Duma, u Massa, u Hadad, u Tema,
u Jetur, u Naphish, bad u Kedema. Kine ki dei ki khun u Ishmael.
Ki khun ka Ketura, ka tnga kliar u Abraham; ka la kha ïa u Zimran, u Jokshan, u Medan, u Midian, Ishbak, bad u Shwa. Ki khun u Jokshan: u Sheba bad u Dedan.
Ki khun u Midian: u Epha, u Epher, u Hanokh, u Abida, bad u Eldaa. Kine baroh ki dei ki khun ki ksiew ka Ketura.
U Abraham u la long u kpa jong u Isaak. Ki khun jong u Isaak pat: u Esaw bad u Israel.
Ki khun u Esaw: u Eliphas, u Rewel, u Jeush, u Jalam bad u Kora.
Ki khun u Eliphas: u Teman, u Omar, u Zephi, u Gatam, u Kenas, u Timna, bad u Amalek.
Ki khun u Rewel kine: u Nahath, u Zera, u Shamma bad u Missa.
Ki khun ki ksiew u Seir ki long kine: u Lotan, u Shobal, u Zibeon, u Ana, u Dishon, u Eser, bad u Dishan.
Ki khun u Lotan ki long: u Hori bad u Homam. Ka Timna ka la long ka para u Lotan.
Ki khun u Shobal ki la long: u Alian, u Manahath, u Ebal, u Shephi, bad u Onam. Ki khun u Zibeon ki la long u Aia, bad u Ana.
U Khun u Ana, u Dishon. Ki khun u Dishon pat kine: u Hamran, u Eshban, u Ithran, bad u Kheran.
Ki khun u Eser ki la long: u Bilhan, u Zaaban, bad u Jaakan. Ki khun u Dishan pat: u Us bad u Aran.
Ki syiem kiba la synshar ha ri Edom shuwa ban synshar ki syiem Israel dei kine harum: u Bela, khun u Beor, u la don ka nongbah kaba kyrteng ka Dinhaba.
Ynda ïap u Bela, u Jobab, khun u Zera, uba na Bozra, u la bud pateng ïa u.
Ynda ïap u Jobab, u Husham uba na ka ri ki Teman u la synshar hadien jong u.
Ynda ïap u Husham, u Hadad, khun u Bedad, uba la jop ïa ki Midian ha ri Moab, u la synshar hadien jong u. Ka kyrteng ka nongbah jong u ka Abith.
Ynda la ïap u Hadad, u Samla uba na Masreka u la synshar hadien jong u.
Ynda la ïap u Samla, u Shaul uba na Rehoboth kaba harud Ïuphratis u la synshar hadien jong u.
Ynda ïap u Shaul, u Baalhanan, khun u Akhbor, u la synshar hadien jong u.
Ynda ïap u Baalhanan, u Hadad u la synshar hadien jong u. Ka kyrteng ka nongbah jong u ka Pai, bad ka tnga jong u ka kyrteng ka Mehetabel, ka khun u Matred, ka khun u Mezahab.
Bad u Hadad u la ïap. Nangta la don ki syiem rit ha Edom: u Timna, u Alia, u Jetheth,
u Oholibama, u Ela, u Pinon,
u Kenas, u Teman, u Mibsar,
u Magdiel, bad u Iram. Kine ki la long ki syiem rit ka Edom.
Ki khun u Israel ki la long kine: u Reuben, u Simeon, u Lebi u Juda, u Issakhar, u Zebulun,
u Dan, u Joseph, u Benjamin, u Naphtali, u Gad, bad u Asher.

Ki khun u Juda ki la long: u Er, u Onan bad u Shela. U la kha ïa kine na ka Bathshwa, ka kynthei Kanaan. Hynrei u khun phrangsngi u Juda, u Er, u la long u badakaid hakhmat u Trai, kumta U la pynïap ïa u.
Ka pyrsa kurim jong u Juda, ka Tamar, ka la kha ha u ïa u Peres bad u Zera, kumta u la don san ngut ki khun baroh.
Ki khun u Peres: u Hesron bad u Hamul.
Ki khun u Zera: u Zimri, u Ethan, u Heman, u Kalkol, bad u Dara, san ngut baroh.
Ki khun u Karmi: u Akhar, uba la pynjynjar ïa ki Israel namarba u pynkheiñ ïa ka adong;
bad u khun jong u Ethan u la long u Azaria.
Ki khun ba kha na u Hesron kine: u Jerahmeel, u Ram bad u Khelubai.
U Ram u la long u kpa u Amminadab, bad u Amminadab u la long u kpa u Nahshon, u khun binong bishon napdeng ki khun u Juda.
U Nahshon u la long u kpa u Salma, u Salma pat u kpa u Boaz.
U Boaz u kpa u Obed, u Obed u kpa u Jesse,
u Jesse u kpa u Eliab, u khun phrangsngi jong u, nangta jong u Abinadab u ba-ar, u Shimea u balai,
u Nethanel u basaw, u Raddai u basan,
u Osem u bahynriew, u Dabid u bahynñiew.
Ki para kynthei jong ki: ka Zeruïa bad ka Abigail. Ki khun ka Zeruïa: u Abishai, u Joab, bad u Asahel, laingut;
ka Abigail pat ka la kha ïa u Amasa, bad u kpa u Amasa u la long u Jether u jait Ishmael.
Na ka tnga jong u ka Asuba, bad na ka Jerioth, u Kaleb, khun u Hesron, u la ïoh kine ki khun: u Jesher, u Shobab bad u Ardon.
Ynda la ïap ka Asuba, u Kaleb u la shong kha ïa ka Ephrath, bad la kha na ka ïa u Hur.
U Hur u la long u kpa jong u Uri bad u Uri u la kha ïa u Besalel.
U Herson u la ïapoikha bad ka khun u Makhir u kpa u Gilead. U la shong kurim ïa ka haba u la hynriewphew snem ka ryta, bad u la ïoh ïa u Segub na ka.
U Segub u la long u kpa u Jair uba la ïoh arphew lai tylli ki shnong ha ri Gilead.
Hynrei u Geshur bad u Aram ki la knieh noh na ki ïa ka Habboth-Jair, ka Kenath bad ki nongrit jong ka, baroh hynriewphew shnong. Kine baroh ki la hiar pateng na u Makhir, u kpa u Gilead.
Ynda la ïap u Hesron, u Kaleb u la shim tnga ïa ka Ephratha, ka tnga u Hesron u kpa lajong, bad ka la kha ïa u Ashhur, u kpa u Tekoa.
Ki khun ki ksiew u Jerahmeel, u khun phrangsngi u Hesron, ki dei kine: u Ram, u khun phrangsngi u Buna, u Oren, u Osem bad u Ahija.
U Jerahmeel u la don sa kawei pat ka tnga kaba kyrteng ka Atara, bad ka la long ka kmie u Onam.
Ki khun u Ram, u khun phrangsngi u Jerahmeel, ki dei kine: u Maas, u Jamin, bad u Eker.
Ki khun u Onam: u Shammai, bad u Jada. Ki khun u Shammai: u Nadab bad u Abishur.
Ka tnga u Abishur ka kyrteng ka Abihail bad ka la kha ïa u Ahban bad u Molid.
Ki khun u Nadab: u Seled bad u Appaim; u Seled u la ïap khlem khun.
U khun u Appaim: u Ishi. U khun u Ishi: u Sheshan. U khun u Sheshan: u Ahlai.
Ki khun u Jada, u para u Shammai: u Jether bad u Jonathan, hynrei u Jether u la ïap khlem khun.
Ki khun u Jonathan: u Peleth bad u Zaza. Kine baroh ki khun ki ksiew u Jerahmeel.
U Sheshan um don khun shynrang, tang ki khun kynthei, hynrei u la don uwei u mraw Ijipt uba kyrteng u Jarha.
Kumta u Sheshan u la ai kurim ïa la ka khun ha u Jarha u mraw jong u, bad ka la kha ïa u Attai.
U Attai u la long u kpa u Nathan, bad u Nathan u la kha ïa u Zabad.
U Zabad u la long u kpa jong u Ephlal bad u Ephlal u la kha ïa u Obed.
U Obed u la long u kpa u Jehu, bad u Jehu u la kha ïa u Azaria.
U Azaria u la long u kpa jong u Heles, bad u Heles u la kha ïa u Eleasa.
U Eleasa u la long u kpa u Sismai, bad u Sismai u kpa u Shallum.
U Shallum u la long u kpa u Jekamia, bad u Jekamia u kpa u Elishama.
Ki khun u Kaleb uba shi para bad u Jerahmeel kine: u Maresha, u khun phrangsngi jong u, uba la long u kpa u Ziph. U khun u Maresha dei u Hebron.
Ki khun u Hebron: u Kora, u Tappua, u Rekem, bad u Shema.
U Shema u la long u kpa u Raham, u kpa u Jorkeam, bad u Rekem u la long u kpa u Shammai.
U khun u Shammai, u Maon, bad u Maon u la long u kpa u Beth-Zur.
Ka Epha ruh, ka tnga kliar u Kaleb, ka la kha ïa u Haran, u Mosa bad u Gases. U Haran u la long u kpa u Gases.
Ki khun u Jahdai: u Rekem, u Jotham, u Geshan, u Pelet, u Epha, bad u Shaaph.
Ka Maaka, ka tnga kliar u Kaleb, ka la kha ïa u Sheber bad u Tirhana.
Ka la kha ruh ïa u Shaaph, u kpa u Madmanna ïa u Sheba, u kpa u Makhbena, bad ïa u kpa u Gibea. Ka khun kynthei u Kaleb ka la long ka Akhsa.
Kine ki la long ki khun ki ksiew u Kaleb. Ki khun u Hur, u khun phrangsngi u Ephratha: u Shobal, u kpa u Kiriath-Jearim,
u Salma, u kpa u Bethlehem, bad u Hareph u kpa u Bethgader.
U Shobal, u kpa u Kiriath-Jearim, u la don sa kiwei pat ki khun: u Haroeh, mar shiteng ki Menuhoth, bad
ki kur jong u Kiriath-Jearim: ki Ithri, ki Puth, ki Shumath, bad ki Mishra kata na kiba la mih ki Zorath bad ki Eshtaol.
Ki khun u Salma: u Bethlehem, ki Netophath, u Atrothbeth Joab, marshiteng ki Manahath, bad ki Zor.
Ki kur jong ki nongthoh kiba shong ha Jabes: ki Tirath, ki Shimeath, bad ki Sukath. Kine ki long ki Ken ba hiar pateng na u Hammath, u kpa ka ïing kur u Rekhab.
Ki khun ba u Dabid u la ïoh ha Hebron dei kine: u khun phrangsngi dei u Amnon, na ka Ahinoam ka nong Jezreel; u ba-ar u Daniel, na ka Abigail ka nong Karmel;
u balai u Absalom, ka kmie jong u ka Maaka ka khun u Talmai, syiem Geshur; u basaw u Adonija, ka kmie jong u ka Haggith;
u basan u Shephatia na ka Abital; u bahynriew u Ithream na ka Ekla ka tnga jong u.
U la ïoh hynriew ngut ki khun ha Hebron, ha ka por ba u synshar hangta hynñiew snem hynriew bnai. Ha Jerusalem u la synshar laiphew lai snem.
Kine ki la long ki khun ba u la ïoh ha Jerusalem: u Shimea, u Shobab, u Nathan bad u Solomon, sawngut na ka Bathshwa, ka khun u Ammiel.
Nangta u Ibhar, u Elishama, u Eliphelet,
u Noka, u Nephek, u Japhia,
u Elishama, u Eliada, bad u Eliphelet, khyndai ngut.
Kine baroh ki khun u Dabid, khlem kheiñ ïa ki khun na ki tnga kliar. Ka Tamar ka la long ka para jong ki.
Ki khun ki ksiew u Solomon dei kine: u Rehoboam; u Abija u khun jong u; u Asa u khun jong u, u Jehoshaphat u khun jong u,
u Joram u khun jong u, u Ahazia u khun jong u, u Jehoash u khun jong u,
u Amazia u khun jong u, u Azaria u khun jong u, u Jotham u khun jong u,
u Ahas u khun jong u, u Hezekia u khun jong u, u Manasse u khun jong u,
u Amon u khun jong u, u Josia u khun jong u.
Ki khun u Josia: u Johanan u khun phrangsngi u ba-ar u Jehoïakim, u balai u Zedekia, u basaw u Shallum.
Ki khun u Jehoïakim: u Jekonia u khun jong u, u Zedekia u khun jong u.
Ki khun u Jekonia u koidi: u Shealtiel,
u Malkhiram, u Pedaïa, u Shenassar, u Jekamia, u Hoshama bad u Nedabia.
Ki khun u Pedaïa ki la long u Zerubbabel bad u Shimei. Ki khun u Zerubbabel ki la long u Meshullam bad u Hanania; ka Shelomith ka la long ka para jong ki.
Ki khun u Meshullam ki la long u Hashuba, u Ohel, u Berekhia, u Hasadia, u Jushab-Hesed, san ngut.
Ki khun u Hanania ki la long: u Pelatia, u Jeshaïa, u Rephaïa, u Arnan, u Obadia, bad u Shekania.
Ki khun u Shekania ki la long u Shemaïa, u Hattush, u Ikal, u Baria, u Nearia, bad u Shaphat, hynriew ngut.
Ki khun u Nearia ki la long u Elioenai, u Hiskia, bad u Asrikam, lai ngut.
Ki khun u Elioenai ki la long u Hodabia, u Eliashib, u Pelaïa, u Akkub, u Johanan, u Delaïa, bad u Anani, hynñiew ngut.
Ki khun ki ksiew u Juda ki la long kine: u Peres, u Hesron, u Karmi, u Hur bad u Shobal.
U Reaïa, u khun u Shobal, u la long u kpa u Jahath, bad u Jahath pat u la long u kpa u Ahumai bad u Lahad. Kine ki la long ki ïing kur Zorath.
Kine ki la long ki khun u Etam: u Jezreel, u Ishma bad u Idbash; ka kyrteng ka para jong ki ka Hasselelponi.
U Penuel u la long u kpa jong u Gedor, bad u Eser u kpa jong u Husha. Kitei baroh ki la long ki khun ki ksiew u Hur, u khun phrangsngi u Ephratha u kpa u Bethlehem.
U Ashhur, u kpa u Tekoa, u la don ar ngut ki tnga, ka Hela bad ka Naara.
Ka Naara ka la kha ïa u Ahussam, u Hepher, u Temeni bad u Ha-ahashtari. Kine ki la long ki khun ki ksiew ka Naara.
Ki khun ka Hela ki la long u Zereth, u Ishar, u Ethnan bad u Kos.
U Kos u la long u kpa jong u Anub bad u Zobeba, bad jong ki ïing kur u Aharhel, u khun u Harum.
U Jabes u la long u bapawnam tam na ki shipara. Ka kmie jong u ka la ai kyrteng Jabes ïa u, ka ong, “Nga la kha shitom ïa u.”

U Jabes u la duwai ïa u Blei ka Israel, “A, lada Men kyrkhu kyrdoh ïa nga bad Men ai ïa nga ki pud ki baïar! To ïarap ïa nga, bad to pyllait ïa nga na kano kano ka apot sniew, ba kan ym pynjynjar ïa nga!” Te u Blei U la ai ïa ka jingkyrpad jong u.
U Khelub, shipara bad u Shuha, u la long u kpa u Mehir, uba la long u kpa u Eshton.
U Eshton u la long u kpa u Bethrapha, u Pasea, bad u Tehinna, u kpa jong u Irnahash. Kine ki la long ki briew na Reka.
Ki khun u Kenas ki la long: u Othniel bad u Seraïa. Ki khun u Othniel ki la long u Hathath bad u Meonothai.
U Meonothai u la long u kpa jong u Ophra, bad u Seraïa u la long u kpa jong u Joab, u kpa u Keharashim, namarba ki dei ki kynja misteri.
Ki khun u Kaleb, u khun u Jephunne: u Iru, u Ela bad u Naam. U khun u Ela: u Kenas.
Ki khun u Jehallelel ki la long: u Ziph, u Zipha u Tiria bad u Asarel.

Ki khun u Esra ki la long: u Jether, u Mered, u Epher, bad u Jalon. Ki khun u Mered, ba la pun bad la kha na ka Bithia ka khun u Pharo ïa kaba u la shong kha, ki la long: u Miriam, u Shammai, bad u Ishba, u kpa u Eshtemoa.
Na ka tnga Ju u la ïoh ïa u Jered u kpa u Gedor, ïa u Heber u kpa u Soko, bad ïa u Jekuthiel u kpa u Zanoa.
Ki khun ka tnga u Hodia, ka para u Naham ki la long: u kpa u Keila nong Garmi bad u kpa u Eshtemoa nong Maakath.
Ki khun u Shimon: u Amnon, u Rinna, u Benhanan, bad u Tilon. Ki khun u Ishi: u Zoheth bad u Ben-Zoheth.
Ki khun u Shela khun u Juda kine: u Er kpa u Leka, u Laada kpa u Maresha, bad ki kur jong ka jait ki nongtrei jaiñ linen kiba ha Beth-Ashbea;
u Jokim, ki nong Koseba, u Joash, bad u Saraph, uba la synshar ha Moab bad la wan phai biang sha Lehem (la tip na ki dulir kiba mynbarim).
Kine ki la long ki nongthaw khiew bad ki la shong ha Netaim bad Gedera. Ki la trei la ktah hangta bad ki la trei ha ka karkhana u syiem.
Ki khun u Simeon ki dei kine: u Nemuel, u Jamin, u Jarib, u Zera, u Shaul;
u Shallum u khun jong u, u Mibsam u khun jong u, u Mishma u khun jong u.
Ki khun u Mishma: u Hammuel u khun jong u, u Zakkur u khun jong u, u Shimei u khun jong u.
U Shimei u la don khathynriew ngut ki khun shynrang bad hynriew ngut ki khun kynthei, hynrei ki hynmen jong u kim da bun khun, kumta ki ïing kur jong ki kim shym roi kat ka jait Juda.
Ki la shong ha Beersheba, Molada, Hazar-Shual,
Bilha, Esem, Tolad,
Bethuel, Horma, Ziklag,
Beth-Markaboth, Hazar-Susim, Beth-Biri, bad Sha-araim. Kine ki la long ki shnong jong ki haduh ka jingsynshar u Dabid.
Ki nongrit jong ki ki la long ka Etam, ka Ain, ka Rimmon, ka Tokhen bad ka Ashan, san shnong,
lem bad kiwei pat ki nongrit sawdong kine ki shnong haduh Baal. Kine ki la long ki jaka shong jong ki, bad la buh jingkynmaw ïa ki shi kur shi kur.
U Meshobab, u Jamlekh, u Josha u khun u Amasia,
u Joel, u Juhu u khun u Joshibia, u khun u Zeraïa, u khun u Asiel,
u Elioenai, u Jaakoba, u Jeshohaïa, u Asaïa, u Adiel, u Jesimiel, u Benaïa,
u Ziza u khun u Shiphi, u khun u Allon, khun u Jedaïa, u khun u Shimri, u khun u Shemaïa
—kine ki briew ba ai kyrteng hangne ki la long ki syiem kur, bad ki jait jong ki ki la roi haduh katta katta.
Ki la leit poi shaduh khap Gedor, shaphang mihngi ka them, ban wad jaka bam phlang ïa ki kynhun langbrot jong ki.
Hangne ki la shem ki jaka bam phlang ki bapahuh bad ki babha, sa ka ri ruh ka bakylluid, ka bajar jar bad ka basuk. Mynshuwa eh la shong hangne ki Ham.

Kine ba la ai kyrteng ki la wan rung ha ki sngi u Hezekia syiem Juda. Ki la pynjot ïa ki ïing shong jong ki bad ïa ki Meunim kiba don hangta haban da duh khoit haduh kane ka sngi, bad ki la buhai shnong ïa ka jaka jong ki namarba la don hangta ki jaka bam phlang na ka bynta ki jynri jong ki.
Kumba sanspah ngut ki khun ki ksiew u Simeon ki la leit sha lum Seir, hapoh ka jingïalam u Pelatia, u Nearia, u Rephaïa bad u Ussiel, ki khun u Ishi;
ki la pynïap ïa ki Amalek phet wir kiba dang sah, bad ki la shong hangta haduh mynta mynne.

Ki khun jong u Reuben, u khun phrangsngi jong u Israel. (Hooid, u dei u khun phrangsngi, hynrei u la pynjah burom ïa ka palong u kpa jong u, kumta ïa ka hok jinglong hynmen la ai noh ha ki khun u Joseph khun u Israel. Kumta ha ka jinghiar pateng ym shym ai kyrteng ïa u katkum ka hok jinglong hynmen.
La u Juda u la kylla u badonbor napdeng shipara, bad ïa u syiem la jied na u, pynban ka hok jinglong hynmen ka dei ka jong u Joseph.)
Ki khun u Reuben, u khun phrangsngi, u Israel: u Hanokh, u Pallu, u Hesron, bad u Karmi.
Ki khun u Joel: u Shemaïa u khun jong u, u Gog u khun jong u, u Shimei u khun jong u,
u Mika u khun jong u, u Reaïa u khun jong u, u Baal u khun jong u,
u Beera u khun jong u, ïa uba u Tiglath-Pileser syiem Assiria u la ring koidi. U la long u syiem rit hapdeng ki Reuben.
Ki kur jong u, shikur shikur, katkum ka jingïadei jong ki: u Jeïel, u rangbah duh, nangta u Zekharia,
u Bela u khun u Asas, u khun u Shema, u khun u Joel, uba la shong ha Aroer shaduh Nebo bad Baal-Meon.
Shaphang mihngi u la shong haduh khap ka ri kynjah kaba kut ha ka Ïuphratis, namarba ki jynri jong ki ki la roi shibun ha ri Gilead.
Ha ki sngi u Saul ki la ïaleh thma ïa ki Hagar. Ynda ki la jop ïa ki, ki la dakhol ïa ki ïingjaiñ jong ki kylleng ka thaiñ mihngi jong ka Gilead.
Ki khun u Gad ki la shong mar syndah bad ki ha ka ri Bashan haduh Saleka:
u Joel u rangbah duh, u Shapham u babud, u Janai, bad u Shaphat ha Bashan.
Ki kur jong ki, shikur shikur, kine: u Mikhael, u Meshullam, u Sheba, u Jorai, u Jakan, u Zia, bad u Eber, hynñiew ngut.
Kine ki long ki khun u Abihail u khun u Huri, khun u Jaroa u khun u Gilead, u khun u Mikhael, khun u Jeshishai, u khun u Jahdo, u khun u Bus.
U Ahi khun u Abdiel, u khun u Guni, u la long u rangbah duh ka ïingkur jong ki.
Ki la shong ha Gilead, ha Bashan bad ki nongrit jong ka, kylleng ki jaka bam phlang jong ka Sharon haduh bakut jong ka.
Ïa kine la thoh kyrteng katkum ki pateng ha ki sngi u Jotham syiem Juda bad ha ki sngi u Jeroboam syiem Israel.

Ki Reuben, ki Gad bad shiteng ka jait u Manasse ki la don ki ’riewïaleh, kiba kieng stieh bad waitlam, kiba nang pyndonkam ryntieh bad kiba tbit ha ka thma, kumba sawphew saw hajar hynñiewspah hynriewphew ngut, baroh ki bakloi ban leit thma.
Haba ki la ïaleh thma ïa ki Hagar, ïa u Jetur, u Naphish, bad u Nodab,

ki la ïoh jingïarap pyrshah ïa ki, kumta ki Hagar bad ki lok jong ki ki la shah rem ha ki kti jong ki. Ki la pyrta sha u Blei ha ka thma bad U la shah shkor ïa ka jingkyrpad jong ki namarba ki la shaniah lut ha U.
Ki la knieh ïa ki jynri jong ki: sanphew hajar ki ut, arspah sanphew hajar ki langbrot, bad arhajar ki kada bad ki la kem sa shispah hajar ki koidi.
Bun bah ki la ïoh pynïap, namar ka la long ka thma u Blei. Ki la buhai shnong ïa ka ri jong ki haduh ka jingring mraw.
Ki khun ki ksiew jong ka shiteng ka jait Manasse ki ïabun, bad ki la shong ha ka ri ka baïar naduh Bashan shaduh Baal-Hermon, Senir, bad lum Hermon.

Ki rangbah duh jong ki ïing kur ki dei kine: u Epher, u Ishi, u Eliel, u Asriel, u Jeremiïa, u Hodabia bad u Jahdiel. Ki la long ki khlawait ki batyng-eh, ki briew ki bapawnam, bad ki rangbah duh jong ki ïing kur.
Hynrei ki la leh bymman pyrshah u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki, bad ki la leh pohjait pohrati da kaba bud ïa ki blei jong ki briew kiba u Blei U la pynduh nakhmat jong ki.

Kumta u Blei U la kynshoit ïa ka mynsiem u Pul syiem Assiria, ïa u Tiglath-Pileser syiem Assiria, kiba la ringmraw ïa ki, ki Reuben, ki Gad bad shiteng ka jait Manasse bad ki la pynshong ïa ki ha Hala, Habor, Hara, bad harud wah Gosan, haduh mynta.
Ki khun ki ksiew u Lebi: u Gershom, u Kohath, bad u Merari.
Ki khun u Kohath: u Amram, u Ishar, u Hebron bad u Ussiel.
Ki khun u Amram: u Aron, u Moses bad ka Miriam. Ki khun u Aron: u Nadab, u Abihu, u Eleasar, bad u Ithamar.
U Eleasar u la long u kpa jong u Phinehas, u Phinehas jong u Abishwa,
u Abishwa jong u Bukki, u Bukki jong u Ussi,
u Ussi jong u Serahia, u Serahia jong u Meraïoth,
u Meraïoth jong u Amaria, u Amaria jong u Ahitub,
u Ahitub jong u Zadok, u Zadok jong u Ahimaaz,
u Ahimaaz jong u Azaria, u Azaria jong u Johanan,
bad u Johanan jong u Azaria (dei une uba la shakri kum u lyngdoh ha ka tempyl ba u Solomon u la tei ha Jerusalem).
U Azaria u la long u kpa u Amaria, u Amaria jong u Ahitub,
u Ahitub jong u Zadok, u Zadok jong u Shallum,
u Shallum jong u Hilkia, u Hilkia jong u Azaria,
u Azaria jong u Seraïa, u Seraïa jong u Jehosadak,
u Jehosadak u la shah ringmraw ha ki kti u Nebukhadnessar, mynba u Trai U la pynryngkangpar ïa ka Juda bad ka Jerusalem.
Ki khun u Lebi ki dei kine: u Gershom, u Kohath, bad u Merari.
Ki kyrteng jong ki khun u Gershom: u Libni bad u Shimei.
Ki khun u Kohath: u Amram, u Ishar, u Hebron bad u Ussiel.
Ki khun u Merari: u Mahli bad u Mushi. Kine ki long ki ïing kur jong ki Lebi shi kpa shi kpa.
Ki jong u Gershom: u Libni u khun jong u, u Jahath u khun jong u, u Zimma u khun jong u,
u Joa u khun jong u, u Iddo u khun jong u, u Zera u khun jong u, u Jeatherai u khun jong u.
Ki jong u Kohath: u Amminadab u khun jong u, u Kora u khun jong u, u Assir u khun jong u,
u Elkana u khun jong u, u Ebiasaph u khun jong u, u Assir u khun jong u,
u Tahath u khun jong u, u Uriel u khun jong u, u Ussia u khun jong u, bad u Shaul u khun jong u.
Ki khun u Elkana: u Amasai bad u Ahimoth,
u Elkana u khun jong u, u Zophai u khun jong u, u Nahath u khun jong u,
u Eliab u khun jong u, u Jeroham u khun jong u, u Elkana u khun jong u.
Ki khun u Samuel: u Joel u khun phrangsngi jong u, bud sa u Abija.
Ki khun u Merari: u Mahli, u Libni u khun jong u, u Shimei u khun jong u, u Ussa u khun jong u,
u Shimea u khun jong u, u Haggia u khun jong u, bad u Asaïa u khun jong u.
Kine ki long ki briew ba u Dabid u la thung ban ïalam jingrwai ha ka tempyl u Trai ynda ka synduk jutang ka la wan sahduh hangta.
Ki dei ki nongrwai hakhmat ka tabernakyl jong ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh haduh ba u Solomon un da tei ïa ka ïing u Trai ha Jerusalem. Ki la pyndep ïa la ki kamram katkum la ka pali pali.
Kine ki long kita ki briew kiba kit kam, bad ki khun jong ki. Ki khun jong u Kohath: u Heman u nongrwai, u khun u Joel, u khun u Samuel,
u khun u Elkana, u khun u Jeroham, u khun u Eliel, u khun u Toa,
u khun u Zuph, u khun u Elkana, u khun u Mahath, u khun u Amasai,
u khun u Elkana, u khun u Joel, u khun u Azaria, u khun u Zephania,
u khun u Tahath, u khun u Assir, u khun u Ebiasaph, u khun u Kora,
u khun u Ishar, u khun u Kohath, u khun u Lebi, u khun u Israel.
U para jong u u Asaph u ïeng ha ka kamon jong u: u Asaph u khun u Berekhia, u khun u Shimea,
u khun u Mikhael, u khun u Baaseïa, u khun u Malkhija,
u khun u Ethni, u khun u Zera, u khun u Adaïa,
u khun u Ethan, u khun u Zimma, u khun u Shimei,
u khun u Jathan, khun u Gershom, u khun u Lebi.
Sha kadiang don ki khun u Merari: u Ethan u khun u Kishi, u khun u Abdi, u khun u Mallukh,
u khun u Hashabia, u khun u Amasia, u khun u Hilkia,
u khun u Amsi, u khun u Bani, u khun u Shemer,
u khun u Mahli, u khun u Mushi, u khun u Merari, u khun u Lebi.
Ïa ki para jong ki, ki Lebi, la pynkyntang na ka bynta ka jingleh niam ha ka tabernakyl jong ka tempyl u Blei.

Hynrei dei u Aron bad ki khun jong u kiba tyrwa jingkñia halor ka duwan ki jynkñia thang bad halor ka duwan Jyniwbih. Dei tang ma ki kiba dei ban leh ïa ki kam ki bakhuid tam bad ban lehniam jingpynbiang na ka bynta ki Israel kumba la hukum u Moses u shakri u Blei.
Kine ki long ki khun u Aron: u Eleasar u khun jong u, u Phinehas u khun jong u, u Abishwa u khun jong u,
u Bukki u khun jong u, u Ussi u khun jong u, u Zerahia u khun jong u,
u Meraïoth u khun jong u, u Amaria u khun jong u, u Ahitub u khun jong u,
u Zadok u khun jong u, bad u Ahimaaz u khun jong u.
Kine ki long ki jaka shong jong ki, katkum ki pud jong ki kyntoit shnong jong ki. Ha ki khun u Aron jong ka ïing kur Kohath hap kine ki bynta.
La ai ha ki ka Hebron ha ri Juda bad ki jaka bam phlang baroh sawdong,
hynrei ïa ki jaka paham jong ka shnong bad ki nongrit jong ka la ai ha u Kaleb u khun u Jephunne.
La ai ha ki khun u Aron ïa ki shnong jaka rieh: ka Hebron, ka Libna bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka, ka Jattir, ka Eshtemoa bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka,
ka Hilen bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka, ka Debir bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka,
ka Ashan bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka, bad ka Beth-Shemesh bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka.

Na ka jait Benjamin, la ai ka Geba bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka, ka Alemeth bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka, bad ka Anathoth bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka. Baroh lang, ki ïing kur jong ki ki la ïoh khatlai shnong.
Ïa kiwei pat ki khun u Kohath la ai da ka jingkhalai nusib shiphew shnong na ki ïing kur jong ka jait, na ka shiteng ka jait, ka shiteng u Manasse.
Ïa ki Gershom la ai bynta katkum ki ïingkur jong ki, khatlai shnong na ki jait u Issakhar, u Asher, u Naphtali, bad u Manasse, ha Bashan.
Ïa ki Merari la ai bynta katkum ki ïing kur jong ki khat-ar shnong na ki jait u Reuben, u Gad bad u Zebulun.
Kumta ki paid Israel ki la ai ïa kine ki shnong bad ki jaka bam phlang ha ki Lebi.
Da ka jingkhalai nusib ki la ai ïa ki na ki jait u Juda, u Simeon, bad u Benjamin, ïa kine ki shnong ba la ïathuh da ka kyrteng.
Don ki ïing kur na ki khun u Kohath kiba la ïoh shnong na ka jait Ephraim.
Ïa ki la ai ki shnong jaka rieh: ka Shekhem bad ki jaka bam phlang ha ri lum Ephraim, ka Gezer bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka,
ka Jokme-am bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka, ka Beth-Horon bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka,
ka Aijalon bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka, ka Gath-Rimmon bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka.
Na ka shiteng ka jait Manasse, ka Aner bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka, bad ka Beleam bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka na ka bynta ki ïing kur jong kiwei pat ki khun u Kohath.
Ïa ki Gershom la ai bynta na ka shiteng ka jait Manasse: ka Golan ha Bashan bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka, bad ka Ashtaroth lem bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka.
Na ka jait Issakhar ka Gedesh bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka, ka Daberath bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka,
ka Ramoth bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka, ka Anem bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka.
Na ka jait Asher: ka Mashal bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka, ka Abdon bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka,
ka Hukok bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka, bad ka Rehob bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka.
Na ka jait Naphtali: ka Gedesh ha Galilea bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka, ka Hammon bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka, bad ka Kiriathaim lem bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka.
Ïa kiwei pat ki Merari la ai bynta na ka jait Zebulun: ka Rimmono bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka, ka Tabor bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka.
Sha shiliang ka Jordan ha Jerikho, na shaphang mihngi ka Jordan, na ka jait Reuben: ka Bezer ha ri kynjah bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka, ka Jahza bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka,
ka Kedemoth bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka, bad ka Mephaath lem bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka.
Na ka jait Gad: ka Ramoth ha Gilead bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka, ka Mahanaim bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka.
Ka Heshbon bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka, bad ka Jazer lem bad ki jaka bam phlang jong ka.
ki khun u Issakhar: u Tola, u Pua, u Jashub, bad u Shimron, saw ngut.

Ki khun u Tola: u Ussi, u Rephaïa, u Jeriel, u Jahmai, u Ibsam bad u Shemuwel, ki rangbah duh ki ïing kur jong u Tola. Shi para kur, ki la don arphew ar hajar hynriewspah ngut ki khlawait ki bakhlaiñ bor ha ka por u Dabid.
U khun u Ussi, u Israhia. Ki khun u Israhia: u Mikhael, u Obadia, u Joel, bad u Isshia, san ngut, baroh kiba long rangbah duh.
Katkum ka jingïadei kur jong ki baroh shi thana, la don laiphew hynriew hajar ngut ki shynrang ba la pyntbit ban ïaleh thma, namar ki don shibun ki tnga bad ki khun shynrang.
Baroh lang ki ïing kur u Issakhar, haba kheiñ katkum ka jinghiar pateng, ki don phraphew hynñiew hajar ngut ki rangïaleh ki bakhlaiñ bor.
Ki khun u Benjamin: u Bela, u Bekher bad u Jediael, lai ngut.

Ki khun u Bela: u Esbon, u Ussi, u Ussiel, u Jerimoth, bad u Iri, san ngut, ki rangbah duh jong ki ïing kur, ki ’riewïaleh ki bakhlaiñ bor. Haba kheiñ da ka jinghiar pateng, ki don arphew ar hajar laiphew saw ngut.
Ki khun u Bekher: u Zemira, u Joash, u Elieser, u Elioenai, u Omri, u Jeremoth, u Abija, u Anathoth, bad u Alemeth. Kine baroh ki dei ki khun u Bekher.
Haba kheiñ ïa ki katkum ka jinghiar pateng, ha la ka ïing kur ïing kur, ki don arphew hajar arspah ngut ki ’riewïaleh.
U khun u Jediael: u Bilhan. Ki khun u Bilhan: u Jeush, u Benjamin, u Ehud, u Shenaana, u Zethan, u Tarshish, bad u Ahishahar.
Kine baroh ki dei ki khun u Jediael, ki rangbah duh jong ki ïing kur, bad ki khlawait. Ki ïa don khathynñiew hajar arspah ngut kiba la tbit ban ïaleh thma.
U Shuppim bad u Huppim… ki khun u Ir. Ki Hushim ki khun u Aher.
Ki khun u Naphtali: u Jahsiel, u Guni, u Jezer, bad u Shallum, ki hiar pateng na ka Bilha.
Ki khun u Manasse: u Asriel, ba kha ka tnga kliar nong Aram. Ka la kha ruh ïa u Makhir u kpa u Gilead.
U Makhir u la shim ka tnga kaba kyrteng Maaka… Ka kyrteng jong u ba-ar u Zelophehad; bad u Zelophehad u la don tang ki khun kynthei.
Ka Maaka ka tnga u Makhir ka la kha u khun bad ka la ai kyrteng Peresh ïa u. U para jong u, u kyrteng, u Sheresh, bad ki khun jong u, u Ulam bad u Rakem.
U khun u Ulam: u Bedan. Kine ki la long ki khun u Gilead u khun u Makhir u khun u Manasse.
Ka para jong u ka Hammolekheth ka la kha ïa u Ishhod, u Abieser bad u Mala.
Ki khun u Shemida ki la long u Ahian, u Shekhem, u Likhi, bad u Aniam.
Ki khun u Ephraim: u Shuthela, bad u Bered u khun jong u, u Tahath u khun jong u, u Eleada, u khun jong u, u Tahath u khun jong u,
u Zabad u khun jong u, u Shuthela u khun jong u, u Eser bad u Elead. Ki nong Gath kiba la kha ha ka ri, ki la pynïap ïa ki namarba kine ki la leit ban lute ïa ki jynri jong ki.
U Ephraim u kpa jong ki u la ïam briew bun sngi, bad ki para jong u ki la wan ban pyntngen ïa u.
U Ephraim u la leit ha ka tnga jong u, kumta ka la pun bad ka la kha ïa u khun. U la ai kyrteng u Beria ïa u namarba ka ïing jong u ka la ngat jingjynjar.
U la don ka khun kynthei kaba kyrteng ka Sheera kaba la tei ïa ka Bethhoron Basharum bad Bashaneng, bad ïa ka Ussen-Sheera.
U Repha u la long u khun jong u, u Resheph u khun jong u, u Tela u khun jong u, u Tahan u khun jong u,
u Ladan u khun jong u, u Ammihud u khun jong u, u Elishama u khun jong u,
u Nun u khun jong u, u Joshwa u khun jong u.

Ki la don ki khyndew ki shyiap bad ki jaka shong ha Bethel bad ki nongrit jong ka, ha Naaran shaphang mihngi, ha Geser bad ki nongrit jong ka shaphang sepngi, ha Shekhem bad ki nongrit jong ka, shaduh Aiïa bad ki nongrit jong ka.

Nangta ter ter khap-pud ki Manasse, ka Beth-Shean bad ki nongrit jong ka, ka Taanakh bad ki nongrit jong ka, ka Megiddo bad ki nongrit jong ka, ka Dor bad ki nongrit jong ka. Ha kine ki jaka la shong ki khun ki ksiew u Joseph khun u Israel.
Ki khun u Asher: u Imna, u Ishba, u Ishbi, u Beria, bad ka para jong ki, ka Sera.
Ki khun u Beria: u Heber bad u Malkhiel. U la long u kpa u Birsaith.
U Heber u la long u kpa u Japhlet, u Shomer, u Hotham bad ka para jong ki, ka Shwa.
Ki khun u Japhlet: u Pasakh, u Bimhal, bad u Ashbath. Kine ki long ki khun u Japhlet.
Ki khun u Shemer u para jong u: u Ahi, u Rohka, u Jehubba, bad u Aram.
Ki khun u Helem u para jong u: u Zopha, u Imna, u Shelesh bad u Amal.
Ki khun u Zopha: u Sua, u Harnepher, u Shual, u Beri, u Imra,
u Bezer, u Hod, u Shamma, u Shilsha, u Ithran, bad u Beera.
Ki khun u Jether: u Jephunne, u Pispa bad u Ara.
Ki khun u Ulla: u Ara, u Haniel bad u Risia.

Kine baroh ki la long ki khun u Asher, ki rangbah duh jong ki ïingkur, ki briew bapawnam, ki ’riewïaleh thma ki batyng-eh bad ki rangbah hapdeng ki ’riewkhraw. Haba ñiew da ka jinghiar pateng, ki don arphew hynriew hajar ngut ki shynrang kiba tbit ïaleh thma.
U Benjamin u la long u kpa jong u Bela u khun phrangsngi, u Ashbel u ba-ar, u Ahara u balai,
u Noha u basaw, bad u Rapha u basan.
U Bela u la don ki khun: u Addar, u Gera, u Abihud,
u Abishwa, u Naaman, u Ahoa,
u Gera, u Shephuphan bad u Huram.
Kine ki long ki khun jong u Ehud (ki long ki rangbah duh jong ki ïing kur kiba shong ha Geba, bad ïa ki la ring mraw sha Manahath):
u Naaman, u Ahija, bad u Gera, kata ka mut, u Heklam, u kpa u Ussa bad u Ahihud.
U Shaharaim u la don ki khun kiba shong ha ri Moab ynda u la beh noh ïa ka Hushim bad ka Baara ki tnga jong u.
Na ka Hodesh, ka tnga jong u, u la ïoh khun: u Jobab, u Zibia, u Mesha, u Malkam,
u Jeus, u Sakhia, bad u Mirma. Kine ki khun jong u, kiba long ki rangbah ïing kur.
U la don khun ruh da ka Hushim: u Abitub bad u Elpaal.
Ki khun u Elpaal: u Eber, u Misham bad u Shemed, kiba la tei ïa ka Ono bad ka Lod lem bad ki nongrit jong ka.
Sa u Beria bad u Shema (kine ki la long ki rangbah jong ki ïing kur kiba shong ha Aijalon bad ki la beh krad ïa ki nong Gath).
Nangta sa u Ahio, u Shashak, bad u Jeremoth.
U Zebadia, u Arad, u Eder,
u Mikhael, u Ishpa, bad u Joha ki la long ki khun u Beria.
U Zebadia, u Meshullam, u Hiski, u Heber,
u Ishmerai, u Islia, bad u Jobab ki la long ki khun u Elpaal.
U Jakim, u Zikhri, u Zabdi,
u Elienai, u Zillethai, u Eliel,
u Adaïa, u Beraïa, bad u Shimrath ki la long ki khun u Shimei.
U Ishpan, u Eber, u Eliel,
u Abdon, u Zikhri, u Hanan,
u Hanania, u Elam, u Anthothija,
u Iphdeïa bad u Penuel ki la long ki khun u Shashak.
U Shamsherai, u Sheharia, u Athalia,
u Jaareshia, u Elija bad u Zikhri ki la long ki khun u Jeroham.
Kine ki la long ki rangbah ïing kur bad ki ’riewpawkhmat katkum ka jinghiar pateng. Ki la shong ha Jerusalem.
U Jeïel kpa u Gibeon u la shong ha Gibeon, bad ka tnga jong u ka kyrteng ka Maaka.
U khun phrangsngi jong u: u Abdon, nangta bud u Zur, u Kish, u Baal, u Nadab,
u Gedor, u Ahio, u Zekher,
bad u Mikloth (une u la long u kpa u Shimea). Kine ruh ki la shong lang shi kur shi jait, mar pyrshah ki kur jong ki ha Jerusalem.
U Ner u la long u kpa jong u Kish, u Kish jong u Saul, u Saul jong u Jonathan, u Malkhishwa, u Abinadab, bad u Eshbaal.
U khun u Jonathan u la long u Meribaal, bad u Meribaal u la long u kpa u Mika.
Ki khun u Mika: u Pithon, u Melekh, u Tarea, bad u Ahas.
U Ahas u la long u kpa jong u Jehoadda, bad u Jehoadda u la long u kpa jong u Alemeth, Asmabeth, bad u Zimri; u Zimri pat u la long u kpa u Mosa.
U Mosa u la long u kpa u Binea. U Rapha u la long u khun jong u, u Eleasa u khun jong u, u Asel u khun jong u.
U Asel u la don hynriew ngut ki khun. Kine ki kyrteng jong ki: u Asrikam, u Bokheru, u Ishmael, u Shearia, u Obadia, bad u Hanan. Kine baroh ki khun u Asel.
Ki khun u Eshek u para jong u: u Ulam u khun phrangsngi, u Jeush u babud, bad u Eliphelet u balai.
Ki khun u Ulam ki la long ki khlawait ki bakhlaiñ bor bad ki nongsiat khnam, bad ki don bun ki khun bad ki khun ksiew, shispah sanphew ngut. Ki dei ki Benjamin baroh phar.

Kumta ïa ki Israel baroh la buh kyrteng shi kur shi kur, katkum ki jinghiar pateng, bad ïa kine la thoh kynmaw ha ka Kitab ki Syiem Israel. Ïa ki Juda pat la ring mraw sha Babilon namarba ki la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah.
Te ki banyngkong ban shong biang ha la ki khyndew ha la ki shnong ki shnong dei ki Israel, ki lyngdoh, ki Lebi bad ki shakri ka tempyl.
Ha Jerusalem la shong ki Juda, ki Benjamin, ki Ephraim, bad ki Manasse.
La don ruh u Uthai khun u Ammihud, u khun u Omri, u khun u Imri, u khun u Bani, na ki khun u Peres, u khun u Juda.
Na ki khun u Shilon la don u Asaïa u khun phrangsngi, bad ki khun jong u.
Na ki khun u Zera la don u Jeuel bad ki kur jong u, hynriewspah khyndaiphew ngut.
Na ki Benjamin, u Sallu u khun u Meshullam, u khun u Hodabia, u khun u Hassenuwa,
u Ibneïa u khun u Jeroham, u Ela u khun u Ussi, u khun u Mikhri, bad u Meshullam u khun u Shephatia u khun u Rewel u khun u Ibnija.
Ki kur jong ki katkum ki jinghiar pateng ki la don khyndaispah sanphew hynriew ngut. Kine baroh ki la long ki rangbah ïing kur, shi kur shi kur.
Napdeng ki lyngdoh la don u Jedaïa, u Jehoïarib, u Jakhin,
bad u Asaria u khun u Hilkia, u khun u Meshullam, u khun u Zadok, khun u Meraïoth, u khun u Ahitub, u nongpynïaid rangbah jong ka tempyl u Blei.
La don ruh u Adaïa u khun u Jeroham, u khun u Pashhur, u khun u Malkhija bad u Maasai u khun u Adiel, u khun u Jahzera, u khun u Meshullam, u khun u Meshillemith, u khun u Immer.
Ki para kur jong ki, ki rangbah ïing kur, ki don shihajar hynñiew spah hynriewphew ngut, baroh kiba tbit ban trei kam shakri ha ïing u Blei.
Napdeng ki Lebi la don: u Shemaïa u khun u Hasshub, u khun u Asrikam, u khun u Hashabia u khun u Merari.
Nangta u Bakbakar, u Heresh, u Galai bad u Mattania u khun u Mika, u khun u Zikhri, u khun u Asaph,
nangta u Obadia, u khun u Shemaïa, u khun u Galal, u khun u Jeduthun bad u Berekhia u khun u Asa, u khun u Elkana uba la shong ha ki nongrit ki Netophath.
Ki nongap jynkhang ki la long: u Shallum, u Akkub, u Talmon, u Ahiman, bad ki kur jong ki (u Shallum u long rangbah).
Mynshuwa ki la long nongap ïa ka khyrdop u syiem ha ka dong ba sha mihngi, mynta ki dei ki nongap ha ka dara ki Lebi.

U Shallum, u khun u Kore, u khun u Ebiasaph, u khun u Kora, bad ki thana jong u na kajuh ka ïing kur ki Kora ki la don ka kamram ban ap ïa ka jaka rung jong ka ïingjaiñ, kumba la ap ki kpa tymmen jong ki ïa ka jaka rung sha ka dara u Trai.
U Phinehas u khun u Eleasar u la long u rangbah jong ki ha ki por mynshuwa: u Trai u la don ryngkat bad u!
U Zekharia, u khun u Mehselemia u la long u nongap jong ka jaka rung sha ka ïingjaiñ jingïakynduh.

Haba kheiñ lang ïa kito baroh kiba la jied ban long nongap khyrdop ha ki jaka rung, don kumba arspah khat-ar ngut. Ïa ki la buh jingkheiñ katkum ka jinghiar pateng ha ki shnong jong ki. U Dabid bad u Samuel men kunok ki la pynskhem ïa ki ha kane ka kam ba lah shaniah.
Kumta ma ki bad ki khun shynrang jong ki ki dei ap ïa ki khyrdop jong ka ïing u Trai, kaba ha kata ka por ka dei tang ka ïingjaiñ.
Ki nongap khyrdop ki don ha ki saw tylli ki dong, mihngi, sepngi, shatei bad shathie.
Ki kur jong ki kiba sah ha la shnong ki wan ïarap bujli ïa ki man la ki hynñiew sngi,
hynrei ki nongap rangbah sawngut ki dei ban don lynter ha ka kam. Kine ki long ki Lebi kiba dei sumar artat ïa ki kamra bad ki spah ki hajar jong ka ïing u Blei.
Ki shong ki sah ha ïing u Blei, namar ki dei ban ap, bad ki dei ban plie ïa ka man ka step.
Don na ki kiba dei sumar ïa ki khiew ki pliang baleh niam, bad ki dei ban da ñiew ïa ki haba pynrung shapoh bad haba sei shabar.
Kiwei pat na ki ki dei peit ïa ki jynbuh jynsat bad ïa ki tiar ki tar leh niam, kumjuh ruh ïa u moida bani, ïa ka waiñ, ka umphniang, ka dhup, bad ki jyniwbih.
Kiwei pat na ki khun ki lyngdoh, ki la pynkhreh ban khleh ïa ki jyniwbih,
bad u Mattithia uwei na ki Lebi, u khun nyngkong u Shallum jait Kora, u dei ban shet ïa ki kpu lyngkniap.
Sa kiwei pat ki thana jong ki na ki Kohath ki dei peit ïa u ’pu-pyni, ban pynkhreh ïa u man la ka sabath.
Te kine ki long ki nongrwai, ki rangbah kur Lebi. Kine ki sah ha ki kamra jong ka tempyl haba lait jyntrei, namar ki dei ban shu don bad sngi bad miet na ka bynta ki jynlehniam.
Kine ki long ki rangbah jong ki ïing kur Lebi bad ki nongïalam, katkum ki jinghiar pateng, bad ki shong ki sah ha Jerusalem.
Ha Gibeon la shong u kpa u Gibeon, u Jeïel, bad ka tnga jong u ka kyrteng ka Maaka.
U khun nyngkong, u Abdon, nangta bud u Zur, u Kish, u Baal, u Ner, u Nadab,
u Gedor, u Ahio, u Zekharia, bad u Mikloth.
U Mikloth u la long u kpa u Shimeam. Kine ruh, para kur, ki la shong mar pyrshah ki kur jong ki ha Jerusalem.
U Ner u la long u kpa u Kish, u Kish u kpa u Saul, u Saul u kpa u Jonathan, u Malkhishwa, u Abinadab, bad u Eshbaal.
U khun u Jonathan u la long u Meribbaal, bad u Meribbaal u la long u kpa u Mika.
Ki khun u Mika: u Pithon, u Melekh, u Tahrea bad u Ahas.
U Ahas u la long u kpa jong u Jara, bad u Jara pat jong u Alemeth, u Asmabeth, bad u Zimri. U Zimri pat u kpa jong u Mosa.
U Mosa pat u kpa jong u Binea; u Rephaïa u la long u khun jong u, u Eleasa u khun jong u, u Asel u khun jong u.
U Asel u la don hynriew ngut ki khun bad kine ki long ki kyrteng jong ki: u Asrikam, u Bokheru, u Ishmael, u Shearia, u Obadia bad u Hanan. Kine ki la long ki khun u Asel.
Ha kata ka por ki Philistia ki la ïaleh thma bad ki Israel. Ki paid Israel ki la phet nakhmat ki Philistia bad ki la shah pynïap halor u lum Gilboa.
Ki Philistia ki la lap ïa u Saul bad ki khun jong u; ki Philistia ki la pynïap ïa u Jonathan, u Abinadab bad u Malkhishwa ki khun u Saul.
Ka thma ka la khia tyngeh pyrshah ïa u Saul, bad ki nongsiat khnam kiba la lap ïa u ki la ïoh pynmynsaw jur ïa u.

Hangta u Saul u la ong ha u nongkieng atiar jong u, “Sei ïa ka waitlam jong phi bad dung ïa nga haban da pei lyngba, ïoh kiba khlem otsher ki wan leh beiñ ïa nga.” Hynrei u nongkieng atiar jong u um treh, namar ba u tieng shikatdei eh. Kumta u Saul u la sei ïa la ka waitlam bad u la noh ïa lade ha ka.
Te haba u nongkieng atiar u la ïohi ba u Saul u la ïap, u ruh u la noh ïa lade ha la ka waitlam bad u la ïap.
Kumta u Saul u la ïap. Ma u, ki khun jong u lai ngut bad kiba ha ïing jong u baroh ki la ïap lang.

Te haba ki paid Israel kiba ha ka them ki la ïohi ba ka kynhun shipai ka la her ïap bad ba u Saul bad ki khun jong u ruh ki la ïap, ki la ieh noh ïa la ki shnong bad ki la phet. Kumta ki Philistia ki la buhai shnong ïa ki.
Kum lashai, haba ki Philistia ki la wan ban loit lyngkhuid ïa kiba la ïap, ki la lap ïa u Saul bad ki khun jong u ba ki la kyllon ïap ha lum Gilboa.
Ki la slied ïa u, ki la rah ïa ka khlieh bad ki atiar thma jong u, bad ki la phah briew kylleng ka ri jong ki ban pynbna ïa ka khubor babha ha ki blei thaw jong ki bad ha ki paidbah.
Ki la wah ïa ki atiar thma ha ka tempyl ki blei jong ki, bad ki la sieh ïa ka khlieh jong u ha ka tempyl u Dakon.
Haba ki nong Jabesh-Gilead baroh ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingleh ki Philistia ïa u Saul,

baroh ki khlawait ki la ïeng, bad ki la leit knieh ïa ka met u Saul bad ïa ki met ki khun jong u, nangta ki la wan rah ïa ki sha Jabesh. Ki la tep ïa ki shyieng jong ki hapoh u dieng bti ha Jabesh bad ki la shah jingit hynñiew sngi.
Kumta u Saul u la ïap namarba um shym ïaineh skhem ha u Trai. Um shym ïaineh skhem ha u Trai namarba u la tamsneng ïa ka hukum u Trai, bad u la wad jingtip sa na ka nongkhan, ba kan bthah buit ïa u,
bad um shym wad jingtip satia na u Trai. Na kane ka daw u Trai U la pynïap ïa u, bad U la pynkynriah ïa ka jinglong syiem sha u Dabid, u khun u Jesse.
Te ki paid Israel baroh ki la ïalum lang sawdong u Dabid ha Hebron, bad ki la ong, “Ngi dei na ka shyieng bad ka doh jong phi.

Ha ki por mynshuwa, wat haba long syiem u Saul, dei ma phi uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ha ki thma baroh. U Trai u Blei jong phi U la ong ha phi, ‘Phin sa long u nongsharai ïa ki paid jong Nga ki Israel, bad phin sa long u kynrad halor jong ki.’ ”

Kumta ki tymmen ki san jong ki Israel, ki la wan sha u syiem ha Hebron, bad u Dabid u la ïateh jutang bad ki ha Hebron hakhmat u Trai. Nangta ki la pynsleh syiem ïa u Dabid halor ki Israel, katkum ka ktien ba la kren u Trai da u Samuel.
Te u Dabid bad ki paid Israel baroh ki la leit sha Jerusalem, kata ka mut Jebus, ha kaba la shong ki briew ba khot kyrteng ki Jebus.
Ki trai shnong Jebus ki la ong ha u Dabid, “Phin ym ïoh rung hangne.” Pynban u Dabid u la ïoh ban knieh ïa ka kut Zion, ka Nongbah u Dabid.
Te u Dabid u la ong, “Jar uba pom nyngkong ïa ki Jebus, uta un sa long u rangbah bad u nongïalam pyrton.” U Joab u khun u Zeruïa u la leit kiew nyngkong, kumta la thung rangbah duh ïa u.
U Dabid u la shong ha kata ka kut, kumta sa khot ïa ka, ka Nongbah u Dabid.
Nangta u la tei ïa ka nongbah baroh sawdong ka Millo, bad u Joab u la maramot ïa ka bynta ba dang sah jong ka nongbah.
U Dabid u la nangkhraw nangkhraw namar u Trai ki paid U la don bad u.
Kine ki long ki rangbah duh jong ki ’riewkhlaiñ u Dabid, kiba kyrshan tyngeh ïa u lem bad ki paid Israel baroh ha ka jingsynshar ba un dup long u syiem kat kum ka ktien u Trai shaphang ki Israel.

Kane ka long ka jingñiew kyrteng ïa ki khlawait u Dabid: u Jashobeam, u nong Hakhmon, u la long u rangbah duh jong ki Laingut. U la talaiñ ïa la u sum pyrshah laispah ngut bad u la pynïap ïa ki ha kajuh ka por.
Mar bud ïa u hapdeng ki Lai ngut ki khlawait dei u Eleasar u khun u Dodo, u nong Aho.
U la don bad u Dabid ha Pas-Dammim mynba ki Philistia ki pynkhreh ïaleh thma. La don kawei ka lyngkha kaba dap da u barli, bad ki pyrton ki la phet nakhmat ki Philistia.
Hynrei ma u u la ïeng ha mar pdeng kata ka lyngkha. U la ïada ïa ka, bad u la pynïap ïa ki Philistia. Kumta u Trai U la pyllait ïa ki da ka jingjop ka bakhraw.
Laingut na ki Laiphew ki rangbah duh ki la leit sha u Dabid ha u mawsiang uba ha ka krem Adullam katba ki Philistia ki dang ïashong ha ki dara jong ki ha them Rephaim.
Ha kata ka por u Dabid u la don ha ka kut, bad ka karod ki Philistia ka la don ha Bethlehem.
U Dabid u la kren angnud, “A ban da don ba wan rah um ïa nga ban dih na ka pukri Bethlehem kaba hajan khyrdop!”

Hangta kita ki khlawait laingut ki la ïaid na mar pdeng ka dara ki Philistia bad ki la tong um na ka pukri Bethlehem, nangta ki la wan rah ïa ka sha u Dabid. Hynrei u Dabid um shym treh dih ïa ka. U la suit ïa ka ha u Trai,

u ong artat, “Da lei lei ngam bit ban leh ïa kane hakhmat u Blei. Dei mo ba ngan dih ïa ka snam kine ki briew? Da ka jingkheiñ duh ïa la ka jingim ki la wan rah ïa ka.” Kumta um shym dih ïa ka. Kat kine kiei kiei kita ki khlawait laingut ki la leh!
U Abishai, shipara bad u Joab, u la long u rangbah duh ki laiphew. U la talaiñ da u sum pyrshah laispah ngut bad u la pynïap ïa ki. Kumta u la ïoh nam bad ki laingut.
U la long u bapawnam tam na ki laiphew bad u la long u rangbah duh jong ki, hynrei um shym ïakot bad ki laingut.

U Benaïa khun u Jehoïada u la long u ’riewshlur na Kabzeel, uba la leh bun ki kam radbah. U la pynïap ar ngut ki ’riewradbah Moab, bad ha kawei ka sngi ba hap ïor u la leit pynïap ïa u sing hapoh krem.

U la pynïap ïa uwei u Ijipt, u briew u bajrong haduh san pruh. Uta u Ijipt u la don ha ka kti u sum u baheh kat u khung u nongthaiñ jaiñ, Hynrei u Benaïa u la tur sha u tang da u diengduh, bad u la ïoh kynthet ïa u sum na ka kti uta u nong Ijipt, nangta u sa pynïap ïa u da u sum jong u hi.
U Benaïa khun u Jehoïada u la leh ïa kine kiei kiei bad u la ïoh nam mar bud ki khlawait laingut.
U la pawnam hapdeng ki laiphew, hynrei um pat ïakot kat ki laingut. U Dabid u la thung rangbah ïa u halor ki nongap karod lajong.
Ki khlawait jong ki pyrton dei kine: U Asahel u para u Joab, u Elhanan u khun u Dodo na Bethlehem,
U Shammoth na Harod, u Helez u nong Pelon,
u Ira u khun u Ikkesh na Tekoa, u Abieser na Anathoth,
u Sibbekai u nong Husha, u Ilai u nong Aho,
u Maharai na Netopha, u Heled u khun u Baana na Netopha,
u Ithai u khun u Ribai na Gibea ki Benjamin, u Benaïa na Pirathon,
u Hurai na ki wahduid ha Gaash, u Abiel u nong Arbath,
u Asmabeth na Baharum, u Eliahba na Shaalbon,
u Hashem u nong Gison, u Jonathan u khun u Shakee na Harar,
u Ahiam u khun u Sakhar na Harar, u Eliphal u khun u Ur,
u Hepher u nong Mekherath, u Ahija u nong Pelon,
u Hesro na Karmel, u Naarai u khun u Esbai,
u Joel u para u Nathan, u Mibhar u khun u Hakri,
u Zelek u nong Ammon, u Naharai na Beeroth u nongkieng atiar u Joab u khun u Zeruïa,
u Ira u nong Ithri, u Gareb u nong Ithri,
u Uria u nong Hit, u Zabad u khun u Ahlai,
u Adina u khun u Shisa jait Reuben, bad u nongïalam ïa ki Reuben bad ki laiphew ngut kiba don lem bad u,
u Hanan u khun u Maaka bad u Joshaphat u nong Mithni,
u Ussia u nong Ashteroth, u Shama bad u Jeïel ki khun u Hotham nong Aroer,
u Jediael u khun u Shimri, bad u Joha u para jong u, u nong Tis,
u Eliel u nong Mahab, u Jeribai, bad u Joshabia ki khun u Elnaam, bad u Ithma u nong Moab,
u Eliel, u Obed, bad u Jaasiel u nong Mesoba.
Kine ki long ki briew kiba la ïasynjuk lang bad u Dabid ha Ziklag, haba um lah ban khih katba mon na ka daw u Saul u khun u Kish. Ki la long ki briew ki bakhlaiñ bor kiba la ïarap ïa u ha ka thma.
Ki la long ki nongsiat khnam, kiba lah ban siat khnam bad kawang maw da ka kamon ne ka kadiang. Ki dei ki Benjamin, ki kur ki jait u Saul.
U nongïalam u la long u Ahieser, nangta u Joash, baroh ar ngut ki khun u Shemaa na Gibea, nangta u Jesiel bad u Peleth ki khun u Asmabeth, u Beraka, u Jehu na Anathoth,
u Ishmaïa na Gibeon, u ’riewkhlaiñ bad u nongïalam ïa ki laiphew, u Jeremiïa, u Jahasiel, u Johanan, u Jozabed na Gedera,
u Elusai, u Jerimoth, u Bealia, u Shemaria, u Shephatia u nong Haruph,
u Elkana, u Isshia, u Asarel, u Joeser, bad u Jashobeam, ki nong Kora,
nangta u Joela bad u Zebadia ki khun u Jeroham na Gedor.

Don ki jait Gad kiba leit ïashah ïa u Dabid mynba u la don ha ka kut ha ri kynjah. Ki la long ki khlawait ki bakhlaiñ bor bad ki batbit bha, bad kiba nang ban pyndonkam bha ïa ka stieh bad u sum. Ki khmat jong ki kum ki sing bad ki stet kum ki khiat halor ki lum.
U rangbah duh jong ki dei u Eser, bud sa u Obadia, u balai u Eliab,
u basaw u Mishmanna, u basan u Jeremiïa,
u Attai u bahynriew, u Eliel u bahynñiew,
u Johanan u baphra, u Elsabad u bakhyndai,
u Jeremiïa u bashiphew, bad u Makhbannai, u bakhatwei.
Kine ki Gad ki dei ki rangbah pyrton, kiba kham hapoh ki dei halor shispah ngut, kiba kham heh halor shihajar ngut.
Dei kine kiba la leit sha shiliang ka Jordan ha u bnai u banyngkong, haba shlei um shaduh rud ka wah, bad kiba la pynher krad ïa kiba don ha them sha mihngi bad sha sepngi.
La don ruh ki Benjamin bad ki Juda kiba la wan sha ka kut u Dabid.

U Dabid u la leit tan ïa ki, u ong, “Lada phi wan sha nga kum ki lok ban ïarap ïa nga, ka dohnud jong nga ka sngewbha ban ïasoh bad phi. Hynrei lada phi wan ban shet kylla ïa nga ha ki nongshun jong nga, wat la ki kti jong nga kim shym leh ei ei ka bymdei, to u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ngi Un ïohi bad Un pynsaja ïa phi.”

Markumta u Mynsiem U la hiar ha u Amasai u nongïalam ki laiphew, bad u la ong, “Ngi long ki jong phi, ko Dabid: tang bad phi, ko khun u Jesse! Ka jingsuk, ha phi, ka jingsuk ha ki nongïarap jong phi! Namar dei u Blei Uba ïarap ïa phi.” Kumta u Dabid u la pdiang ïa ki bad u la pynlong ïa ki ki rangbah pyrton jong u.

La don ki Manasse kiba wan phet sha u Dabid haba u la mih lang bad ki Philistia ban ïaleh thma ïa u Saul. (Hynrei um shym ïarap ïa ki namar ki rangbah Philistia ynda ki la ïapyrkhat lang, ki la phah noh ïa u, ki ong, “Kin leit ki khlieh jong ngi lada un phet sha u kynrad jong u, u Saul.”)
Katba u dang leit sha Ziklag, kine ki Manasse ki la wan phet sha u: u Adna, u Josabad, u Jediael, u Mikhael, u Josabad, u Elihu, bad u Zillethai, ki rangbah duh jong ki bun hajar ha Manasse.
Ki la ïarap ïa u Dabid pyrshah ka kynhun ki nonglute, namar ki la long ki ’riewïaleh ki bakhlaiñ, bad ki la long ki rangbah pyrton.
Na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat ki briew ki ïawan ïarap ïa u Dabid haduh ba ka kynhun shipai ka la heh la kum ka kynhun shipai u Blei.
Kine ki long ki jingkheiñ ïa ki paid pyrton kiba la kieng atiar bha kiba la wan sha u Dabid ha Hebron ban pynkhamti ïa ka jinglong syiem u Saul ha u katkum ka hukum u Trai.
Kiba na Juda kiba rah stieh rah sum ki la long hynriew hajar phraspah ngut ki ’riewïaleh kiba la kieng atiar.
Na ki Simeon, ki ’riewïaleh thma ki bakhlaiñ bor ki la long hynñiew hajar shispah ngut.
Na ki Lebi saw hajar hynriew spah ngut,
nalor u Jehoïada u rangbah ki kur u Aron uba la don bad u lai hajar hynñiewspah ngut.
U Zadok, u samla ’riewïaleh u bakhlaiñ bor u la don arphew ar ngut ki rangbah pyrton na ïing kur.
Na ki Benjamin, ki kur u Saul, don lai hajar ngut baroh shi katta, kiba bun na ki, ki la bud ïa ka ïing kur u Saul.
Na ki Ephraim, arphew hajar phraspah ngut ki ’riewïaleh, ki briew ki bapawnam ha ka kur.
Na shiteng ka jait Manasse, khatphra hajar ba la mang da ka kyrteng ban wan thung syiem ïa u Dabid.
Na ki Issakhar, ki briew kiba nang ban bishar ïa ki por, ban sngewthuh aïu ki Israel ki dei ban leh, la don arspah ngut ki rangbah, bad baroh shi kur hapoh ka jingïalam jong ki.
Na ki Zebulun, sanphew hajar ki pyrton kiba la ïaw bha, kiba la biang bha ki tiar ïaleh thma, ban ïarap ïa u Dabid tang kawei ka jingthmu.
Na ki Naphtali, shihajar ki rangbah ryngkat bad laiphew hynñiew hajar ki pyrton kiba kieng ka stieh bad u sum.
Na ki Dan, arphew phra hajar hynriewspah ngut kiba la pyntbit na ka bynta ka thma.
Na ki Asher, sawphew hajar ki pyrton kiba la paka bha na ka bynta ka thma.
Na ki Reuben, ki Gad, bad na shiteng ka jait Manasse kaba ha shiliang ka Jordan, shispah arphew hajar ngut ki pyrton kiba la biang ki jait tiar thma baroh nadong shadong.

Kine baroh ki ’riewthma, kiba la pura bha ki tiar thma kum ha ka jingïaleh, ki la wan sha Hebron da ka jingthmu ka baskhem ban pynbna syiem ïa u Dabid halor ka ri Israel baroh. Kiwei pat ki Israel ruh ki la don kajuh ka jingmut ban thung syiem ïa u Dabid.
Ki la sah lai sngi bad u Dabid, bad ki la ïabam ïadih, naba ki hymnen para jong ki, ki la pynkhreh na ka bynta jong ki.

Ki para jait jong ki naduh Issakhar, Zebulun bad Naphtali ki la wan kit da ki kada, ki ut, ki khashor, bad ki masi, shi sbing ki jait jynbam kiba da u ’purew, da ki kpu soh dymbur, da ki tyrjup soh waiñ tyrkhong, da ka waiñ bad ka umphniang, halor ki masi bad ki langbrot, namar la don ka jingkmen ha Israel.
Te u Dabid u la wad jingmut na ki rangbah jong ki hajar bad ki spah bad na ki nongïalam baroh.

U Dabid u la ong ha kata ka jingïalang paidbah jong ki Israel baroh, “Lada phi sngewdei, bad lada ka long ruh ka mon u Trai u Blei jong ngi, to ngin ïaphah briew sha kiwei pat ki hynmen para jong ngi baroh kiba don kylleng ka ri Israel, bad sha ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ruh kiba shong ha ki shnong ba don jaka bam phlang, ba kin ïawan lang bad ngi.
Nangta to ngin ïawan rah biang sha ngi ïa ka synduk u Trai jong ngi, naba ngi la leh bym suitñiew ïa ka ha ki sngi u Saul.”
Ka jingïalang baroh kawei ka la mynjur ban leh kumta, namar ka long ka jingleh ka badei katkum ka jingpeit ki paidbah.
Kumta u Dabid u la lum paidbah ïa ki Israel baroh naduh Shihor ha Ijipt haduh lynti khim Hamath, ban wan rah ïa ka synduk u Blei na Kiriath-Jearim.

Te u Dabid u la leit kiew ryngkat bad ki Israel baroh sha Baala, kata ka mut, sha Kiriath-Jearim ka shnong Juda ban rah noh na kata ka jaka ïa ka synduk u Blei, ïa kaba la ai kyrteng “U Trai uba shong khet halor ki kherubim.”
Te ki la kit ïa ka synduk u Blei ha ka kali bathymmai na ïing u Abinadab; u Ussa bad u Ahio ki la ñiah ïa ka kali.
U Dabid bad ki paid Israel ki la ïaleh kmen hakhmat u Trai katba don la ka bor, da ki jingrwai, ki duitara, ki marynthing, ki shakuriaw, ki ’singpadiah bad ki turoi.
Ynda poi ha kyntem u Khidon, u Ussa u la kner ïa la ka kti ban bat ïa ka synduk, namarba ki masi ki la jynthut.
U Trai U la khie bitar lep ïa u Ussa bad U la shoh ïa u namarba u la ktah da ka kti jong u ïa ka synduk. Kumta u la ïap hakhmat u Blei.
U Dabid u la sngewkhuslai namarba ka jingbitar u Trai ka la mih kynsan halor u Ussa. Ïa kane ka jaka la khot Peres-Ussa haduh kine ki sngi.
U Dabid u la sheptieng ïa u Trai ha kata ka sngi, bad u la ong, “Kumno keiñ ngan leit rah ïa ka synduk u Blei sha ïing jong nga?”
Kumta u Dabid um shym leit rah ïa ka synduk sha ka Nongbah u Dabid, hynrei u la rah ïa ka sha ïing u Obed-Edom nong Git.
Ka synduk u Trai ka la sah ha ïing u Obed-Edom bad kiba ha ïing ha sem jong u lai bnai. U Trai U la kyrkhu kyrdoh ïa ka ïing ka sem u Obed-Edom bad ïa kiei kiei baroh katba u don.
Te u Hiram syiem Tirus u la phah ki nonglam ktien sha u Dabid lem bad ki dieng kedar, ki misteri maw bad ki misteri dieng ban tei ïa ka ïing syiem jong u.
U Dabid u la sngewthuh ba u Trai U la pynskhem syiem ïa u halor ki Israel, bad ïa ka jingsynshar jong u la kyntiew burom na ka bynta ki paid jong U ki Israel.
Te u Dabid u la shim tnga shuh shuh ha Jerusalem bad u la kha bun ki khun shynrang bad khun kynthei.
Ki kyrteng jong ki khun ba u la ïoh ha Jerusalem ki la long: u Shammuwa, u Shobab, u Nathan, u Solomon,
u Ibhar, u Elishwa, u Elpelet,
u Noka, u Nephek, u Japhia,
u Elishama, u Beeliada, bad u Eliphelet.
Haba ki Philistia ki la ïohsngew ba ïa u Dabid la pynsleh syiem halor ki Israel baroh, ki la mih jrim baroh ban leit wad ïa u. Tang shu ïohsngew ïa kane, u Dabid u la leit tur pyrshah ïa ki.
Ki Philistia ki la hiar thma ha ka them Rephaim.
U Dabid u la wad jingtip na u Blei, “Hato ngan leit ïaleh ïa ki Philistia? Hato Men aiti ïa ki ha ka kti jong nga?” Te u Trai U la jubab, “Khie leit, bad Ngan aiti ïa ki ha ka kti jong phi.”

Hangta u Dabid u la leit ïaleh ïa ki ha Baal-Perasim bad u la jop ïa ki. Nangta u Dabid u la ong, “U Blei U la sam lyngba ki nongshun da ki kti jong nga, kumba tynrah ka jingshlei um.” Kumta ïa kata ka jaka la ai kyrteng Baal-Perasim.
Ki la ieh noh ïa la ki blei ha kata ka jaka, bad u Dabid u la ai hukum ban thang ïa ki.
Sa shisien ki Philistia ki la wan hiar thma sha kata ka them.
Haba u Dabid u la wad jingtip na u Blei, u Blei U la ong ha u, “Phim dei ban leit beh nadien jong ki; ïaid tawiar bad ïaleh ïa ki na pyrshah ki dieng Balsam.
Ynda phi ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa kumba ïaid ki kjat ha kliar ki dieng Balsam, hangta tur ban ïaleh, namar u Blei U la leit ha shuwa jong phi ban pom ïa ki Philistia.”
Te u Dabid u la leh kumba u Blei U la hukum ïa u, bad ki la pynïap ïa ki Philistia naduh Gibeon haduh Gezer.
Ka nam u Dabid ka la phriang kylleng ka ri baroh, bad u Trai U la pynlong ba ki jait bynriew kin sheptieng ïa u.
U Dabid u la tei ïa ka ïing na ka bynta ïa lade ha ka Nongbah u Dabid, u la pynkhreh ka jaka na ka bynta ka synduk u Blei bad u la pynïeng kawei ka ïingjaiñ na ka bynta jong ka.
Te u la ong, “Ym dei mano mano hynrei tang ki Lebi kiba lah ban rah ïa ka synduk u Blei, namar u Trai U la jied ïa ki ban rah ïa ka synduk u Blei, bad ban shakri ïa U shi junom.”
Kumta u Dabid u la lum lang ïa ki Israel baroh ha Jerusalem, ban wan rah ïa ka synduk u Trai sha ka jaka ba u la pynkhreh na ka bynta jong ka.
Te u Dabid u la lum lang ïa ki khun u Aron bad ki Lebi,
ïa ki khun u Kohath, u Uriel, u rangbah jong ki bad shispah arphew ngut ki para kur jong u,
ïa ki khun u Merari, u Asaïa u rangbah jong ki bad arspah arphew ngut ki para kur jong u,
ïa ki khun u Gershom, u Joel u rangbah jong ki bad shispah laiphew ngut ki para kur jong u,
ïa ki khun u Elisaphan, u Shemaïa u rangbah jong ki bad arspah ngut ki para kur jong u,
ïa ki khun u Hebron, u Eliel u rangbah jong ki bad phraphew ngut ki kur jong u,
ïa ki khun u Ussiel, u Amminadab u rangbah jong ki bad shispah khat-ar ngut ki para kur jong u.
Te u Dabid u la khot sa ïa u Zadok bad u Abiathar ki lyngdoh, bad ïa u Uriel, u Asaïa, u Joel, u Shemaïa, u Eliel, bad u Amminadab ki Lebi,

bad u la ong ha ki, “Phi long ki rangbah jong ki ïingkur Lebi. To pynkhuid pynkyntang ïa lade ma phi bad ki kur ki jait jong phi, bad to wan rah ïa ka synduk u Trai u Blei ki Israel sha ka jaka ba nga la pynkhreh na ka bynta jong ka.
Dei namarba phim shym rah ïa ka ha ka sien ka banyngkong ba u Trai u Blei jong ngi U la patied kynsan halor jong ngi. Dei namar ba ngim shym salia ban leh kumba la hukum.”
Kumta ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ki la pynkhuid ïa lade ban rah ïa ka synduk u Trai u Blei ki Israel.
Te ki Lebi ki la bah ïa ka synduk u Blei halor ki tyrpeng jong ki da ki dieng kumba u Moses u la hukum, katkum ka ktien u Trai.
U Dabid u la hukum ïa ki rangbah jong ki Lebi ban buh na ki kur jong ki ki nongrwai kiban tem jam ïa ki jyntem, ïa ka duitara, ka marynthing bad ki ’sing padiah, ban pynmih ki sur jingkmen.
Kumta ki Lebi ki la thung ïa u Heman khun u Joel; na ki para jong u ïa u Asaph u khun u Berekhia; na ki khun u Merari, kiba shi kur bad ki, ïa u Ethan u khun u Kushaïa;

nangta kiba bud ha ki, ki para kur jong ki hi, ban don ryngkat bad ki, dei u Zekharia, u Jaasiel, u Shemiramoth, u Jehiel, u Unni, u Eliab, u Benaïa, u Maaseïa u Mattithia, u Eliphelehu, bad u Mihneïa, sa ki nongap khyrdop pat u Obed-Edom bad u Jeïel.
Ki nongrwai, u Heman, u Asaph bad u Ethan, ki dei ban tem ïa ki ’sing padiah rnong.
U Zekharia, u Asiel, u Shemiramoth, u Jehiel, u Unni, u Eliab, u Maaseia bad u Benaïa ki dei ban tem ïa ki marynthing katkum ka “Alamoth.”
Hynrei u Mattithia, u Eliphelehu, u Mikneïa, u Obed-Edom, u Jeiel, bad u Asasia ki dei ban ïalam da ki duitara katkum ka “sur Sheminith.”
U Shenania, u nongïalam jingrwai ki Lebi, u dei ban ïalam ïa ki jingrwai, namar u long u bastad ha kane ka kam.
U Berekhia bad u Elkana ki dei ban long ki nongap khyrdop hakhmat ka synduk.

Ki lyngdoh u Shebania, u Joshaphat, u Nethanel, u Amasai, u Zekharia, u Benaïa, bad u Elieser, ki dei ban put ïa ki ronsing hakhmat ka synduk u Blei. U Obed-Edom bad u Jehia ki la long ruh ki nongap khyrdop hakhmat ka synduk.
Kumta u Dabid bad ki tymmen ki san Israel bad ki rangbah pyrton jong ki hajar, ki la leit ban wanrah ïa ka synduk jutang u Trai na ïing u Obed-Edom da ka jingshadkmen.
Katba ki Lebi, da ka jingïarap u Blei, ki la bah ïa ka synduk ka jutang u Trai, ki la kñia hynñiew tylli ki masi dab bad hynñiew tylli ki blang.
U Dabid u la kup da ka jaiñ linen bani, kumjuh ruh ki Lebi baroh kiba bah ïa ka synduk, ki nongrwai, bad u Khenania u nongïalam ïa ki nongrwai. U Dabid u la kup sa ka ephod.
Kumta ki Israel baroh ki la wan rah ïa ka synduk jutang u Trai da ki ronsing bad ki ’singpadiah, bad ki la pynlong ki jingrwai ki bajam da ki duitara bad ki marynthing.

Te katba ka synduk jutang u Trai ka dang rung hapoh ka Nongbah u Dabid, ka Mikhal, ka khun u Saul kaba la peit na ka khalki, ka la ïohi ba u syiem Dabid u shad bad u leh kmen, bad ka la ibeiñ ïa u ha la ka dohnud.
Ki la wan rah ïa ka synduk u Blei bad ki la buh ïa ka hapoh ka ïingjaiñ ba la thaw khnang u Dabid na ka bynta jong ka. Nangta ki la tyrwa ki jynkñia thang bad ki jynkñia ïabha ïamiat, hakhmat u Trai.
Te haba u Dabid u la dep ban tyrwa ïa ki jynkñia thang bad ki jynkñia jingsuk, u la kyrkhu ïa u paidbah ha ka kyrteng u Trai.
Hadien kata u la sam ha ki Israel baroh, rangbah bad kynthei, mar uwei u kpu, mar shi lyngkhot ka doh bad mar shi lyngkniap u kpu soh waiñ.
Nalor kata u la thung katto katne ngut ki Lebi ban lehniam hakhmat ka synduk u Trai, ban kyrpad, ban ainguh, bad ban ïaroh ïa u Trai, u Blei ki Israel.

U Asaph u la long u rangbah, bad sa u Zekharia, nangta u Jeïel, u Shemiramoth, u Jehiel, u Mattithia, u Eliab, U Benaïa, u Obed-Edom, bad u Jeïel. Kine ki dei ban tem ïa ki duitara bad ki marynthing; u Asaph pat u dei ban tem ïa ki ’singpadiah.
U Benaïa bad u Jehasiel ki lyngdoh ki dei ban put khlem sangeh ïa ki turoi hakhmat ka synduk u Blei.
Te ha kata kajuh ka sngi, u Dabid u la thung ïa u Asaph bad ki para kur jong u ban rwai nyngkong eh ïa kine ki jingrwai ainguh ha u Trai.
To ainguh ïa u Trai, to nam ïa ka kyrteng jong U, to pynbna ïa ki kam jong U ha ki jait bynriew !
To rwai ïa U, to rwai ïaroh ïa U, to ïathuh ïa ki kam phylla jong U !
To leh kmen ha ka kyrteng bakhuid jong U; to shadkmen, ko dohnud ba wad ïa u Trai !
To wad ïa u Trai bad ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong U, to wad ïa ka khmat jong U khlem sangeh !
To kynmaw ïa ki kam phylla ba U la leh, ïa ki kambah jong U, ïa ki rai ba U la ai,
ko khun u Abraham, u shakri jong U, ko khun u Jakob, phi ki ba la jied jong U !
U dei u Trai u Blei jong ngi; ki rai jong U halor ka pyrthei satlak.
U kynmaw ïa la ka jutang junom, ïa la ka hukum shihajar pateng bynriew,
ïa ka jutang ba U la ïateh bad u Abraham, ïa la ka jingkular ba U la smai ha u Isaak,
kaba U la pynskhem kum ka aiñ ha u Jakob, kum ka jutang bymjukut ha u Israel.
“Ha phi Ngan ai ïa ka ri Kanaan,” U la ong, “kum ka rikynti jong phi.”
Mynba ki dang ïadon tang khyndiat, dang shi dana, kum ki mynder hangta,
kiba shu shang na kawei ka ri sha kawei pat, na kawei ka hima sha kiwei pat ki jait bynriew,
Um shym shah ïano ïano ban krenbeiñ ïa ki; U la kynhied ïa ki syiem na ka bynta jong ki,
U la ong, “Hei! wat ktah kti ïa ki ba la sleh jong Nga, ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong Nga wat leh sniew !”
To rwai ha u Trai, ko pyrthei baroh ! Pynbna ïa ka jingpynim jong U ha la ka sngi.
To ïalap ïa ka burom jong U ha ki jait bynriew, ïa ki kam phylla jong U ha u bynriew baroh,
naba u Trai U long u bakhraw, ïa U dei ban ïaroh jam, ïa U dei ban tieng burom halor ki blei baroh.
Naba ki blei jong ki jait bynriew ki dei ki blei thala, hynrei u Trai U la thaw ïa ki bneng.
Hakhmat jong U tang ka burom bad ka jingkhraw bor, ha ka jaka bakhuid jong U ka bor bad ka jingkmen suda.
Ko kynhun ki jait bynriew, to ai nam ïa u Trai, to ai ha u Trai ïa ka nam jong ka burom bad ka bor !
To ai burom ïa u Trai kumba dawa ka kyrteng jong U; to rah ka jyntyrwa, to wan hakhmat jong U !
To khynñiuh hakhmat jong U, ko khyndew baroh: ka pyrthei ba U la thaw ban ïeng skhem, ban ym khih junom.
To ki bneng kin sngewbha, to ka pyrthei kan shadkmen; to ïathuh ïa ki jait bynriew, “U Trai U synshar !”
Te ka duriaw kan kyrhuh, bad baroh kiba don ha ka, to ki lyngkha kin risa, bad baroh kiba don ha ki.
Te ki dieng jong ka khlaw kin rwai da ka jingkmen hakhmat u Trai, namarba U wan— U wan ban synshar ïa ka khyndew.
To ainguh ïa u Trai namar U long u babha, naba ka jingieid baskhem jong U ka neh junom !

To ong: “To pyllait ïa ngi, ko Blei, ko nongpynim jong ngi; to lum, to pyllait ïa ngi na kiwei pat ki jait bynriew, ba ngin dup ainguh ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong Me, ba ngin dup shem jingkmen ha kaban ïaroh ïa Me.
Long ba la kyrkhu u Trai, u Blei ki Israel, na bymjukut sha bymjukut !” Te u paidbah baroh u la jubab, Amen ! Alleluïa !
Kumta u Dabid u la ieh noh ïa u Asaph bad ki para kur jong u hangta hakhmat ka synduk jutang jong u Trai, ban leh niam khlem sangeh hakhmat ka synduk katba donkam man la ka sngi.
La don ruh u Obed-Edom bad ki para kur jong u hynriewphew phra ngut. U Obed-Edom u khun u Jeduthun, bad u Hosa ki la long ki nongap khyrdop.
U la ieh noh ïa u lyngdoh Zadok bad ïa ki para kur lyngdoh jong u hakhmat ka tabernakyl jong u Trai kaba don ha ka jaka lum ha Gibeon,
ban tyrwa jynkñia thang khlem sangeh ha u Trai ha ka duwan jynkñia thang mynstep bad janmiet, kumba la thoh ha ka aiñ u Trai kaba U la hukum ïa ki Israel.
La don ruh bad ki u Heman bad u Jeduthun lem bad kiwei pat ïa kiba la lah jied bad la ai kyrteng kyrpang ban ainguh ïa u Trai, namarba ka jingieid sbun jong U ka neh skhem junom.
U Heman bad u Jeduthun ki don ki turoi bad ki ’singpadiah bad ki jyntem na ka bynta ki jingrwai leh niam. Ïa ki khun u Jeduthun la buh ban ap ïa ka khyrdop.
Nangta baroh u paidbah u la leit noh sha la ïing la ïing, bad u Dabid u la leit phai ban kyrkhu ïa ka ïing lajong.
Ynda u Dabid u la shong ha ïing lajong, u la ong ha u Nathan nongïathuhlypa, “Ha peit, nga shong ha ka ïing kedar, hynrei ka synduk jutang jong u Trai ha ka ïingjaiñ.”
Te u Nathan u la ong ha u Dabid, “Leh katba don ha ka dohnud jong phi naba u Blei U don bad phi.”
Hynrei ha kata hi ka miet ka ktien u Trai ka la wan ha u Nathan
“Khie leit ïathuh ïa u shakri jong Nga u Dabid, ‘U Trai U ong kumne: phin ym tei ïa ka ïing ba Ngan shong.
Ngam pat ju shong ha ka ïing naduh ba Nga la ïalam ïa ki Israel haduh kane ka sngi, hynrei Nga la leit na kawei ka ïingjaiñ sha kawei pat, na kawei ka jaka shong sha kawei pat.

Ha ki jaka baroh ba Nga la leit ryngkat bad ki Israel, hato Nga la ong shikyntien ha kino kino ki nongbishar ka Israel ïa kiba Nga la hukum ban sharai ïa ki paid jong Nga, balei sha phim tei da ka ïing dieng kedar ïa Nga ?’

Namarkata mynta phin ong kumne ha u shakri jong Nga u Dabid ‘U Trai ki paid U ong kumne, Nga la shim ïa phi na jaka bam phlang, na ka jingsharai langbrot, ba phin long u nongïalam ïa ki paid Israel jong Nga.
Nga la don ryngkat bad phi kat shaba phi leit, bad Nga la pom ïa ki nongshun baroh nakhmat jong phi, bad Ngan ai ïa phi ka nam ka bakhraw kat ka nam jong ki briew ki ba khraw tam ha ka pyrthei.

Ngan buh kawei ka jaka na ka bynta u paid Israel jong Nga. Ngan pynskhem ïa ki hangta ba kin ïoh shong ha la ka jaka khlem da pynsatia shuh ïa ki. Kumta ki ’riewdakaid kin ym pynjot shuh ïa ki kum mynshuwa,

ha ki por ba Nga la buh ki nongbishar halor ki paid Israel jong Nga, bad Ngan sa pyndem ïa ki nongshun jong phi baroh. Nalor kata Nga pynbna ha phi ba Nga u Trai, Ngan sa pynlong ïa phi ka jait syiem.
Ynda la poi ka sngi ba phi dei ban leit noh bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi, Ngan sa pynïeng uwei na ki khun jong phi ban mih bteng ïa phi, bad Ngan sa pynskhem ïa ka jinglong syiem jong u.
Ma u un sa tei ka ïing na ka bynta jong Nga, bad Ngan sa pynskhem ïa ka khet jong u junom.
Ngan sa long u kpa jong u, bad un sa long u khun jong Nga. Ngan ym weng noh ïa ka jingieid jong Nga na u, kumba Nga la weng noh na uto uba ha shuwa jong phi.
Ngan sa pynskhem ïa u ha ka ïing jong Nga bad ha ka hima jong Nga junom, kumta ïa ka khet jong u yn sa pynneh shi junom.’ ”
U Nathan u la ïathuh ïa kine ki ktien baroh ha u Dabid, katkum ka jingïohi paw ba u la ïohi.
Te u syiem Dabid u la leit rung bad u la shong hakhmat u Trai, u ong, “Uei ma nga a Trai ko Blei, bad kaei eh ka Ïing syiem jong nga, ba Me la kyntiew haduh katne ?

Bad namar kane kam pat biang ha ki khmat jong Me, ko Blei, Me la kren ruh shaphang ka Ïing u shakri jong Me na ka bynta bun ki sngi kiban dang wan, bad Me la pyni ha nga ïa ki pateng bynriew kiba hadien habud, a Trai ko Blei !
Aïu pat u Dabid un dang lah ban ong shuh ha Me na ka bynta kane ka burom ïa u shakri jong Me? Me la mang ïa u shakri jong Me.
Na ka bynta u shakri jong Me, a Trai, bad katkum ka dohnud jong Me, Me la leh ïa kane ka kam ka bakhraw kaba Me pynpaw ïa ka jingkhraw ka ban sa wan.
Ym don mano mano kum ma Me, a Trai, bad ym don Blei nalor jong Me, kat kumba ngi la ïohsngew da ki shkor jong ngi.

Hato don ma kawei pat ka jait bynriew ha pyrthei kum ki paid Israel jong Me, ba u Blei hi Un siewspah ïa ki ban long u paid bynriew lajong, da kaba pynpaw nam ïa lade, da kaba leh ïa ki kam ki bakhraw bad ki bashyrkhei, da kaba pynher krad ïa kiwei pat ki jait bynriew nakhmat u paid jong Me, ïa uba Me la pyllait mraw na Ijipt?
Te Me la pynlong ïa ki paid Israel ki briew jong Me junom. Bad ma Me, ko Trai, Me la kylla long u Blei jong ki.
Te mynta, a Trai, ai ba ka ktien ba Me la kren shaphang u shakri jong Me bad shaphang ka Ïing syiem jong u kan neh skhem junom. To pynurlong ïa kata kaba Me la kular,
ba ka nam jong Me kan skhem bad kan nangkhraw haba ki ong, ‘U Trai ki paid, u Blei ki Israel, U long u Blei ka Israel,’ bad ba ka Ïing u shakri jong Me u Dabid kan ïaineh skhem hakhmat jong Me.
Namarba ma Me, ko Blei, Me la pynpaw ha u shakri jong Me ba Men sa seng kawei ka Jait syiem na ka bynta jong u, u shakri jong Me u la sngew shlur ban duwai hakhmat jong Me.
Te mynta, a Trai, namar Me long u Blei Uba la kular ïa kane kaei kaei ka babha ha u shakri jong Me,
to sngewbha ban kyrkhu ïa ka Jait syiem u shakri jong Me ba kan dup ïaineh ha Me junom. Naba kata ïa kaba ma Me, a Trai, Me la kyrkhu, shi junom.”
Hadien kane u Dabid u la jop ïa ki Philistia bad u la pyndem ïa ki. U la knieh ïa ka Gath bad ki nongrit jong ka na ka kti ki Philistia.
U la jop sa ïa ki Moab, bad ki Moab ki la kylla ki raïot u Dabid bad ki la hap siew khajna.
U Dabid u la jop ruh ïa u Hadar-ezer syiem Zoba ha Hamath, mynba une u la leit ban pynïeng ïa u mot harud wah Ïuphratis.

U Dabid u la ïoh knieh na u shihajar tylli ki kali, u la kem koidi hynñiew hajar ngut ki pyrton shongkulai, bad arphew hajar ngut ki pyrton kjat. Nangta u Dabid u la thait ïa ki thied khohwah jong ki kulai kali baroh, lait noh kat ban biang ïa ki shispah tylli ki kali.
Haba ki Siria kiba na Damaskus ki la wan ïarap ïa u Hadar-ezer syiem Zoba, u Dabid u la pynïap arphew ar hajar ngut ki Siria.
Kumta u Dabid u la buh ki karod ha ki thaiñ Damaskus jong ka Siria, bad ki Siria ki la kylla ki raïot u Dabid bad ki la siew khajna. U Trai U la ai jingjop ïa u Dabid kat shaba u leit.
U Dabid u la knieh ïa ki stieh ksiar ba rah ki pyrton u Hadar-ezer bad u la wan rah ïa ki sha Jerusalem.
Na Tibhath bad na Kun, ki shnong u Hadar-ezer, u Dabid u la knieh shikatdei bah ka rnong, bad dei da kane ba u Solomon u sa ïoh tei ïa ka dabor rnong, ïa ki rishot, bad ïa ki khiew ki pliang rnong.
Haba u Tou syiem Hamath u la ïohsngew ba u Dabid u la jop ïa ka pyrton shipai baroh kawei jong u Hadar-ezer u syiem Zoba,

u la phah ïa la u khun u Hadoram sha u Dabid ban ai khublei bad ban leh burom ïa u namarba u la ïaleh bad u la jop ïa u Hadar-ezer. Bunsien u Hadar-ezer u la ïaleh thma bad u Tou. Te u la phah bun jait ki mar ksiar, rupa bad rnong.
Ïa kine baroh u Dabid u la aiti kyntang ha u Trai, ryngkat bad ka rupa bad ka ksiar ba u la knieh na Edom, na ki Moab, na ki Ammon, na ki Philistia bad ki Amalek.
U Abishai, u khun u Zeruïa u la pynïap khatphra hajar ngut ki Edom ha them Mluh.
U la buh ki karod ha Edom, bad ki Edom ki la kylla ki raïot u Dabid. U Trai U la ai jingjop ïa u Dabid kat shaba u leit.
Kumta u Dabid u la synshar halor ki Israel baroh, bad u la pynïaid da ka hok bad jingleh beit ïa ki paidbah baroh.
U Joab khun u Zeruïa u la long u rangbah duh jong ki pyrton, u Jehoshaphat khun u Ahilud u la long u nongsumar dulir,
u Zadok khun u Ahitub bad u Ahimelekh khun u Abiathar ki la long ki lyngdoh, bad u Shusha u la long u nongthoh.
U Benaïa u khun u Jehoïada pat u la long u rangbah pyrton halor ki Khereth bad ki Peleth, bad ki khun u Dabid ki la long ki rangbah kitkam kiba ha syndah eh jong u syiem.
Te nadien kane u Nahash syiem ki Ammon u la ïap, bad u khun jong u, u la mih bteng ïa u.

U Dabid u la ong, “Ngan leh sbun ïa u Hanun u khun u Nahash, namar u kpa jong u u la leh sbun kylliang ïa nga.” Kumta u Dabid u la phah ki nonglam ktien ban pyntngen ïa u shaphang u kpa jong u. Ki shakri u Dabid ruh ki la wan sha u Hanun ha ka ri ki Ammon ban pyntngen ïa u.

Pynban ki rangbah nongïalam jong ki Ammon ki la ong ha u Hanun, “Phi ngeit ba u Dabid da kaba u la phah briew ban pyntngen ne ban burom ïa u kpa jong phi? Ym dei pynban ba ki shakri jong u ki la wan ban peit siar, ban pynkhyllem, bad ban syntiat ïa ka ri?”
Kumta u Hanun u la shim ïa ki shakri u Dabid, u la khi ïa ki, bad u la khap ïa ki jaiñkup jong ki namar pdeng haduh skhep, nangta u sa phah noh ïa ki.

Te ki la wan noh. Ynda la ïathuh ha u Dabid shaphang kita ki briew, u la phah briew ban ïakynduh ïa ki, namar kita ki la sngewlehraiñ haduh katta katta. U syiem u la ong, “To sah ha Jerikho haduh ban da san ki ’ñiuhtmoh, nangta sa wan phai.”

Haba ki Ammon ki la sngewthuh ba ki la kylla long ki nongshun jong u Dabid, u Hanun bad ki Ammon ki la phah shihajar talen ka rupa ban leit wai kali, bad ban wer shipai kulai na Mesopotamia, na Aram-maaka, bad na Zoba.

Ki la wer laiphew-ar hajar ki kali, bad u syiem Maaka u la wan bad la ki pyrton jong u. Ki la pynïeng dara hakhmat ka Medeba. Sa ki Ammon baroh ki la mih jrim na ki shnong jong ki bad ki la wan sha ka thma.
Ynda u Dabid u la ïohsngew ïa kata, u la phah ïa u Joab bad ïa ki khlawait jong u baroh shipyrton.
Ki Ammon ki la mih bad ki la ïeng riang ban ïaleh ha khyrdop shnong, ki syiem pat kiba la wan kyrpang ki la ap ha madan palat shnong.
Haba u Joab u la ïohi ba ïa ka thma la pyn-ap pyrshah ïa u na shakhmat bad shadien, u la jied katto katne ki ’rangdajied na ki Israel bad u la pynïeng riang ïa ki pyrshah ki Siria.
Ïa kiwei pat ki pyrton u la buh hapoh ka jingïalam u Abishai, u para jong u, bad kine ruh ki la ïeng riang pyrshah ki Ammon.
U la ong, “Lada ki Siria ki khlaiñ eh ïa nga, phin sa wan ïarap, hynrei lada ki Ammon ki khlaiñ eh ïa phi, ngan sa wan ïarap ïa phi.
To long ki bashlur, bad to leh rangbah na ka bynta ki paidbah jong ngi bad na ka bynta ki shnong u Blei. To u Blei Un leh katba ibit ma U.”
Kumta u Joab bad ki pyrton kiba bad u ki la tur sha ki Siria ban ïaleh thma, bad kine ki la phet krad hakhmat jong u.
Haba ki Ammon ki la ïohi ba ki Siria ki la her ïap, ma ki ruh ki la phet krad nakhmat u Abishai, u para u Joab, bad ki la rung hapoh shnong. Nangta u Joab u la wan phai sha Jerusalem.

Te haba ki Siria ki la ïohi ba ki la shah rem ha ki Israel, ki la phah ki nongrah khubor bad ki la pynkhih ïa ki Siria baroh kiba sha shiliang ka Ïuphratis, hapoh ka jingïalam u Shophakh, u rangbah duh ki pyrton, u Hadar-ezer.

Ynda la ïathuh ïa u Dabid shaphang kane, u la lum lang baroh ki Israel, u la jam sha shiliang ka Jordan, u la tur sha ki bad u la pynïeng riang ïa la ki pyrton ha pyrshah jong ki. Haba u Dabid u la pynïeng ïaleh ïa ki Siria, kine ki la ïaleh bad u.
Ki Siria ki la phet krad nakhmat ki Israel, bad u Dabid u la ïoh pynïap na ki Siria hynñiew hajar ki shipai kali, sawphew hajar ki pyrton kjat, wat ïa u Shophakh u rangbah duh ki pyrton jong ki.
Haba ki shakri u Hadar-ezer ki la ïohi ba ki la shah rem ha ki Israel, ki la ïasuk bad u Dabid, bad ki la kylla ki raïot jong u. Naduh kata ki Siria ki da ngiah ban ïarap shuh ïa ki Ammon.

Ha ka pyrem jong ka snem ka babud, ka por ba ki syiem ki ju leit ïaleh thma, u Joab u la ïalam ïa la ki pyrton bad u la pynjulor ïa ka ri ki Ammon, bad u la kerkut ïa ka Rabba. Hynrei u Dabid u la sah ha Jerusalem. U Joab u la ïaleh ïa ka Rabba bad u la jop ïa ka.

Te u Dabid u la shim ïa ka pansngiat na ka khlieh u syiem jong ki, bad u la shem ba ka khia kat shitalen ka ksiar. Ka la don uwei u mawkordor, bad la pynphong ïa ka halor ka khlieh u Dabid. U la wan kit shikatdei ka bai kliar wait na kata ka shnong.

U la ïalam koidi ïa ki briew nangta, bad u la pyntrei ïa ki da ki kurat, ki nar puh bad ki sdie. Ha kajuh ka rukom u Dabid u la leh ïa ki shnong Ammon baroh. Hadien kata u Dabid bad ki pyrton jong u baroh ki la wan phai sha Jerusalem.
Hadien kane la khie ka thma bad ki Philistia ha Gezer. Ha kata ka por u Sibbekai nong Hushath u la pynïap ïa u Sippai, uwei na ki khun ki ksiew ki ’riewradbah, kumta ïa ki Philistia la pyndem.
La don biang sa kawei pat ka thma bad ki Philistia. U Elhanan u khun u Jair u la pynïap ïa u Lahmi, uba shipara bad u Goliath nong Git, uba la don u sum uba kat u khung u nongthaiñ jaiñ.

La don sa kawei pat ka thma ha Gath, ha kaba la don uwei u briew uba la jrong khyllah. Une u la don hynriew shympriah’ti ha man la ka kti, bad hynriew shympriah’jat ha man la ka kjat, arphew saw tylli baroh. Une ruh u la hiar pateng na ki ’riewradbah.
Haba u la pynsatia ïa ki Israel, u Jonathan u khun u Shimea, uba shipara bad u Dabid, u la pynïap ïa u.
Kine ki dei kiba la hiar pateng na ki ’riewradbah ha Gath. Kine baroh ki la ïap da ka kti u Dabid bad ki pyrton jong u.
Te u Soitan u la ïeng pyrshah ïa ki Israel, bad u la kynshoit ïa u Dabid ban ñiew ïa ki Israel.
Kumta u Dabid u la ong ha u Joab bad ki rangbah pyrton, “Khie leit ñiew ïa ki Israel naduh Beersheba haduh Dan, bad sa wan ai jingkheiñ ïa nga ba ngan dup tip ïa ka jingbun jong ki.”

Hynrei u Joab u la ong, “Ai u Trai Un pynroi wat shispah shah ïa u paid jong U! Ko syiem kynrad jong nga, hato kine baroh kim dei hi ki shakri jong u kynrad jong nga? Balei keiñ u kynrad jong nga un da kwah ïa kane ? Balei un da pynbit pop ïa ki Israel ?”
Hynrei ka lah ka ktien u syiem ïa u Joab. Kumta u Joab u la mih bad u la leit kylleng ka ri Israel, nangta u la wan phai sha Jerusalem.
Te u Joab u la ai jingkheiñ ïa ki briew ba la ñiew ha u Dabid. Ha ri Israel baroh la don khatwei lak ki rangbah rah waitlam, bad ha ri Juda saw spah hynñiewphew hajar ki rangbah rah waitlam.
Um shym kynthup ïa ki Lebi bad ki Benjamin ha ka jingñiew, namar u Joab u la sngewngiah ïa ka hukum u syiem.
Hynrei u Blei U la sngewsih ïa kane bad U la sympat ïa ki Israel.
Te u Dabid u la ong ha u Blei, “Nga la leh pap shibun eh haba nga la leh ïa kane. Hynrei nga kyrpad ïa Me mynta ban weng noh ïa ka jingbymman u shakri jong Me, naba nga la leh biej shibun eh.”
Kumta u Trai U la kren ha u Gad, u kunok u Dabid,
“Khie leit ïathuh ha u Dabid, ‘U Trai U ong kumne, Nga tyrwa ha phi lai tylli kiei kiei, jied kawei, bad Ngan leh ïa kata ha phi.’ ”
Kumta u Gad u la wan sha u Dabid bad u la ong ha u, “U Trai U ong kumne, ‘Jied kano phi mon:

Lai snem ka ’nemsniew; lane lai bnai ka jingpynjot da ki nongshun jong phi kiba tur ïa phi katba lap; lane lai sngi da ka waitlam u Trai, ka khlam ha ka ri, bad u angel uba pynjulor kylleng ka ri Israel.’ To rai mynta ngan leit ïathuh kumno ha Uta Uba la phah ïa nga.”
