Te u Dabid u la ong ha u Gad, “Nga la hap ha ka lanot ka bakhraw. Ieh ngan mat hap ha ka kti u Trai, namar ka jingisynei jong U ka long ka bakhraw. Hynrei wat ai ba ngan hap ha ka kti u briew.”
Kumta u Trai U la phah ka khlam ha ri Israel, bad la ïap hynñiewphew hajar ki rangbah Israel.

U Blei U la phah ïa u angel ban pynjot ïa ka Jerusalem. Hynrei hamar ba un sa pynjot ïa ka, u Trai U la peit isynei bad U la kylla noh ïa ka jingmut shaphang ka jingpynjynjar. Kumta U la ong ha u angel nongpynjot, “La biang; pynsangeh noh ïa ka kti jong phi.” Uta u angel u Trai u ïeng hajan ka kyntem u Ornan nong Jebus.

U Dabid u la khmied ïa la ki khmat bad u la ïohi ba u angel u Trai u ïeng hapdeng ka khyndew bad ka bneng, bad ba u bat kawei ka waitlam lymbuit kaba thew halor ka Jerusalem. Hangta u Dabid bad ki tymmen ki san kiba la kup da ki jaiñ byrni ki la dem pyllup.

Te u Dabid u la ong ha u Blei, “Hato ym dei ma nga uba la hukum ban ñiew ïa ki paidbah? Dei ma nga uba la leh pop bad uba la leh kam bymman. Hynrei kine ki langbrot, aïu ki la leh? Nga kyrpad ïa Me, a Trai ko Blei jong nga, sympat ïa nga bad ïa ka ïing u kpa jong nga, hynrei wat phah ïa ka khlam halor ki briew jong Me.”
Te u angel u Trai u la ong ha u Gad ban ïathuh ïa u Dabid ba u dei ban leit thaw ka duwan u Trai ha ka kyntem u Ornan u nong Jebus.
Kumta u Dabid u la leit kumba la ong u Gad uba la kren ha ka kyrteng u Trai.
U Ornan u dang shoh kew; haba u la kyrtiang, u la ïohi ïa u angel, bad ki khun jong u sawngut kiba ïadon bad u ki la leit rieh ïa lade.
Katba u Dabid u dang leit sha u Ornan, u Ornan u la ïohi ïa u. U la mih na kyntem bad da ka khmat sha khyndew u la nguh la dem burom ïa u Dabid.
U Dabid u la ong ha u Ornan, “To ai noh ha nga ïa ka jaka kyntem ba ngan ïoh tei hangne ïa ka duwan ha u Trai. Ai ïa ka katkum ka dor ka bapura, khnang ban pynsangeh noh ïa ka khlam na ki paidbah.”

Te u Ornan u la ong ha u Dabid, “Shim seh. To u syiem kynrad jong nga un leh ïa ka katba u ibit. Peit, ngan ai ruh ki masi na ka bynta ka jynkñia thang, ki shaka kyntem ban pynlong diengïap, bad u kew na ka bynta ka jynkñia kpu. Ngan ai baroh katba don.”
Hynrei u syiem Dabid u la ong ha u Ornan, “Em, ngan da siew kat ka dor ka bapura. Ngam dei ban shu shim ei ïa ka jong phi na ka bynta u Trai, ne ban tyrwa jynkñia khlem da lut ei ei ma nga.”
Kumta u Dabid u la siew dor ïa kata ka jaka hynriew spah shekel ka ksiar da ka jynthew.
Te u Dabid u la tei ka duwan ha u Trai, bad u la tyrwa ki jynkñia thang bad ki jynkñia ïabha ïamiat. U la khot kyrpad ïa u Trai bad u Trai U la jubab da ka ding na bneng halor ka duwan jynkñia thang.
Kumta u Trai U la hukum ïa u angel ban thep noh ïa ka waitlam ha ka sop jong ka.
Te haba u Dabid u la ïohi ba u Trai U la jubab ïa u ha ka kyntem u Ornan nong Jebus, u la tyrwa jynkñia ha kata ka jaka.
Ka tabernakyl u Trai kaba u Moses u la thaw ha ri kynjah, bad ka duwan jynkñia thang ki la don ha kata ka por ha ka jaka kynjang ha Gibeon.
Hynrei u Dabid um shym lah satia ban leit hakhmat jong ka ban wad jingtip na u Trai, namarba u la sheptieng eh ïa ka waitlam u angel u Trai.
Te u Dabid u la ong, “Hangne kan long ka ïing u Trai u Blei, hangne kan don ka duwan jynkñia thang na ka bynta ki Israel.
U Dabid u la ai hukum ban lum lang ïa ki soh shnong kiba shong ha Israel, bad u la buh ki nongshtah maw ban pynkhreh ki maw shniah na ka bynta ban tei ïa ka ïing u Blei.
U Dabid u la taïar lypa shikatdei bah u nar ban shna prek na ka bynta ki jynkhang jong ki khyrdop bad ki jynpyndait, bad shibun bah ka rnong haduh bym lah thew shuh,
nangta sa ki dieng kedar ruh byllien bah, namar ki Sidon bad ki Tirus ki la wan rah shikatdei ki dieng kedar sha u Dabid.

Naba u Dabid u la ong, “U Solomon u khun jong nga, u dang khynnah bad um pat ïaw jingtip, bad ka ïing ba dei ban tei na ka bynta u Trai ka dei ban long kaba palat liam ha ka jingitynnat, ka nam bad ka burom kylleng ki ri baroh. Nga dei namarkata ban pynkhreh na ka bynta jong ka.” Kumta u Dabid u la taïar shikatdei bah ki tiar ki tar shuwa ban ïap.
Te u la phah khot ïa u Solomon u khun jong u, bad u la ai hukum ïa u ban tei ka ïing na ka bynta u Trai, u Blei ki Israel.
U Dabid u la ong ha u Solomon, “Ko khun jong nga, nga la kwah hir hir naduh dohnud ban tei kawei ka ïing ha ka kyrteng u Trai u Blei jong nga.

Hynrei ka ktien u Trai ka la wan ha nga, ka ong, ‘Phi la pynphlei snam shibun bad phi la ïaleh ki thma ki bakhraw, phim dei ban tei ka ïing ha ka kyrteng jong Nga, namarba phi la pynphlei snam hakhmat jong Nga ha ka pyrthei.

Phin sa ïoh u khun, u ban sa long u briew ka jingsuk. Ngan sa ai jingsuk ïa u na ki nongshun jong u baroh sawdong. Ka kyrteng jong u kan sa long u Solomon bad Ngan sa ai ka jingsuk bad ka jingpalei ha Israel ha ki sngi jong u.
Un sa tei ka ïing na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong Nga. Un sa long u khun jong Nga bad Ngan sa long u kpa jong u, bad Ngan sa pynskhem ïa ka khet syiem jong u ha Israel junom.’
Mynta, ko khun jong nga, to u Trai Un don ryngkat bad phi, khnang ba phin dup lah ban tei ïa ka ïing u Trai u Blei jong phi kumba u la kren shaphang jong phi..
To u Trai Un ai ïa phi ka jingsian bad ka jingshemphang, ba ynda U ai bor ïa phi halor ki Israel phin dup lah ban rakhe ïa ka aiñ u Trai u Blei jong phi.
Hangta phin sa manbha lada phi leh sumar ban rakhe ïa ki aiñ bad ki rai kiba u Trai U la hukum ha u Moses na ka bynta ki Israel. To long u bakhlaiñ bad u bashlur. Wat sheptieng bad wat sngewkyïuh.

Da ka jingshitom ka bakhraw nga la taïar na ka bynta ka ïing u Trai shispah hajar talen ka ksiar, shimilian talen ka rupa, ka rnong bad u nar bym lah thew shuh, ba la bun eh; ki dieng bad u maw ruh nga la pynbiang. Sa nang pyndap shuh shuh ma phi ha kine.
Phi don byllai ki nongtrei, ki nongshtah maw, ki misteri maw bad ki misteri dieng, nalor ki nongtrei kiba nang ban trei kano kano ka jingtrei.
Shaphang ka ksiar, ka rupa, ka rnong bad u nar ym lah kheiñ shuh. Sdang ban trei noh, bad to u Trai Un don ryngkat bad phi !”
U Dabid u la ai hukum ruh ïa ki rangbah nongïalam baroh jong ki Israel ban ïarap ïa u Solomon u khun jong u, u ong,

“Hato u Trai u Blei jong phi Um don bad phi? Hato Um shym la ai jingsuk ïa phi na kylleng sawdong? Naduh ba U la aiti ïa ki trai shnong jong ka ri ha ka kti jong nga, ïa ka ri la pyndem na ka bynta u Trai bad u paid jong U.

Mynta to pynbeit ïa la ki jingmut bad ki dohnud ban wad ïa u Trai u Blei jong phi. Ïeng joit bad to tei ïa ka jaka kyntang jong u Trai u Blei, khnang ba ïa ka synduk jutang u Trai bad ïa ki khiew ki pliang bakhuid jong u Blei yn dup wan rah ha ka ïing ba la tei na ka bynta ka kyteng u Trai.”
Haba u Dabid u la tymmen bad ki sngi jong u ki la pura, u la thung syiem ïa u Solomon u khun jong u halor ki Israel.
U Dabid u la lum lang ïa ki nongïalam baroh jong ki Israel lem bad ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi.
Ïa ki Lebi kiba naduh laiphew snem shaneng la ñiew, bad ki la don laiphew phra hajar ngut baroh.
“Arphew saw hajar na kine,” u Dabid u la ong, “ki dei ban peit ïa ka kam ha ka ïing u Trai, hynriew hajar pat de kin long ki rangbah pynïaid kam bad ki nongbishar,
saw hajar ngut ban ap khyrdop, bad sa saw hajar ngut pat kin ai jingïaroh ïa u Trai da ki Jyntem ba nga la thaw na ka bynta kane ka jingthmu.”
U Dabid u la pynbeit kynhun ïa ki katkum ki khun u Lebi: u Gershom, u Kohath bad u Merari.
Ki khun u Gershom ki la long u Ladan bad u Shimei.
Ki khun u Ladan: u Jehiel u nongïalam, nangta u Zetham bad u Joel, lai ngut.
Ki khun u Shimei: u Selomoth, u Hasiel bad u Haran, lai ngut. Kine ki la long ki nongïalam ïa ki ïing kur u Ladan.
Ki khun u Shimei: u Jahath, u Zina, u Jeush, bad u Beria. Kine saw ngut ki la long ki khun u Shimei.
U Jahath u la long u nongïalam, bud u Ziza; hynrei u Jeush bad u Beria kim don khun shibun, kumta la kheiñ lang ïa ki kum kawei ka ïing kur.
Ki khun u Kohath: u Amram, u Ishar, u Hebron, bad u Ussiel, saw ngut.

Ki khun u Amram: u Aron bad u Moses. Ïa u Aron la buh kyrpang ban pynkyntang ïa kiei kiei ki bakhuid tam, ba ma u bad ki khun jong u kin thang jyniwbih junom hakhmat u Trai, kin shakri ïa U, bad kin kyrkhu ha ka kyrteng jong U junom.
Hynrei ïa ki khun u Moses, u briew u Blei, la ñiew kyrteng bad ka jait Lebi.
Ki khun u Moses: u Gershom bad u Elieser.
Ki khun u Gershom: u Shebuwel, u nongïalam.
Ki khun u Elieser: u Rehabia u nongïalam; u Elieser um don kiwei pat ki khun, hynrei ki khun u Rehabia ki la don shibun bah.
Ki khun u Ishar: u Shelomith, u nongïalam.
Ki khun u Hebron: u Jeria u nongïalam, u Amaria u babud, u Jahasiel u balai, bad u Jekameam u basaw.
Ki khun u Ussiel: u Mika u nongïalam bad u Isshia u babud.
Ki khun u Merari: u Mahli bad u Mushi. Ki khun u Mahli: u Eleasar bad u Kish.
U Eleasar u la ïap khlem khun shynrang, tang ki khun kynthei suda. Ki kur jong ki, ki khun u Kish, ki la ïapoikha bad ki.
Ki khun u Mushi: u Mahli, u Eder, bad u Jeremoth, lai ngut.
Kine ki khun u Lebi katkum ki ïing kur bad ki nongïalam rangbah jong ki ïing kur kumba la ñiew kyrteng ïa ki uwei pa uwei. Ki dei ban trei kam niam ha ïing u Trai naduh arphew snem ka ryta shaneng,
katkum ka hukum bakhatduh jong u Dabid ban pyntrei kam ïa ki Lebi naduh arphew snem ka ryta.
Naba u Dabid u la ong, “U Trai u Blei ki Israel, U la ai jingsuk ha ki briew jong U, bad U shong junom ha Jerusalem.
Kumta ki Lebi kim donkam shuh ban rah ïa ka tabernakyl ne kino kino ki tiar jong ka.

Hynrei kin don ka deiti ban ïarap ïa ki khun u Aron na ka bynta ki Jynleh niam ha ka ïing u Trai, ban sumar ïa ki phyllaw bad ki kamra, ban pynkhuid ïa kiei kiei ki bakhuid, bad ban leh ïa kano kano ka kam shakri ha ïing u Blei;

ban ïarap ïa u ’pu-pyni, ïa u moida na ka bynta ka jingkñia kpu, ïa ki ’pulyngkniap bakhlem thiat, ïa ki kpu syang, ïa ki jyntyrwa bakhleh bad ka umphniang, bad ïa ki kynja jynthew baroh shaphang ka jingbun ne jingheh.
Ki dei ban ïeng man ka step ban ainguh bad ban ïaroh ïa u Trai, bad kin leh kumjuh ynda premmiet,
katba tyrwa Jynkñia thang ha u Trai ha ki sngi sabath, ki sngi ’naithymmai bad ki sngi khawai niam, katta ngut katba donkam ïa ki, barabor hakhmat u Trai.
Ha kane ka rukom kin sumar ïa ka ïingjaiñ jingïakynduh bad ïa ka jaka kyntang, bad kin ïarap kam ïa ki khun u Aron, ïa ki hynmen para jong ki, na ka bynta ki kam leh niam ha ïing u Trai.”
Ka jingbuh kyrdan ïa ki khun u Aron ka long kumne. Ki khun u Aron: u Nadab, u Abihu, u Eleasar, bad u Ithamar.
U Nadab bad u Abihu ki la ïap shuwa u kpa jong ki bad kim shym don khun, kumta u Eleasar bad u Ithamar ki long lyngdoh.
Da ka jingïarap jong u Zadok, uwei na ki khun u Eleasar, bad jong u Ahimelekh, uwei na ki khun u Ithamar, u Dabid u la pynbeit ïa ki pali jinglehniam jong ki.
Namar la don kham bun ki ’riewrangbah na ki khun u Eleasar ban ïa na ki khun u Ithamar, ki la bate ïa ki ïing kur u Eleasar khathynriew kynhun bad ïa ki jong u Ithamar phra kynhun.
Ki la bate ïa ki kumjuh kumjuh da kaba shu khalai nusib, kumta la don ki nongtrei rangbah na ka bynta ka jaka kyntang bad na ka bynta u Blei na ki khun u Eleasar, bad na ki khun u Ithamar.

Te u Shemaïa nongthoh, khun u Nethanel, u Lebi, u la kyntiew kyrteng ïa ki hakhmat u syiem, ki rangbah kitkam, u Zadok lyngdoh, u Ahimelekh khun u Abiathar bad ki rangbah ïing kur lyngdoh bad ïing kur Lebi. La jied kawei ka ïing kur na ka liang u Eleasar bad kawei na ka liang u Ithamar.
Ha ka jingkhalai banyngkong la ïoh u Jehoïarib, ha ka ba-ar u Jedaïa,
ha ka balai u Harim, ha ka basaw u Seorim,
ha ka basan u Malkhija, ha ka bahynriew u Mijamin,
ha ka bahynñiew u Hakkos, ha ka baphra u Abija,
ha ka bakhyndai u Jeshwa, ha ka bashiphew u Shekania,
ha ka bakhatwei u Eliashib, ha ka bakhat-ar u Jakim,
ha ka bakhatlai u Happa, ha ka bakhatsaw u Jeshebeab,
ha ka bakhatsan u Bilka, ha ka bakhathynriew u Immer,
ha ka bakhathynñiew u Hesir, ha ka bakhatphra u Happises,
ha ka bakhatkhyndai u Pethahia, ha ka ba-arphew u Jeheskel,
ha ka ba-arphew wei u Jakhin, ha ka ba-arphew ar u Gamul,
ha ka ba-arphew lai u Delaïa, ha ka ba-arphew saw u Maasia.

Kine ki dei ki briew ba la buh ryntih katkum la ka kam ka kam. Ki dei ban wan sha ka ïing u Trai katkum ka jingpynbeit ba la pynskhem na ka bynta jong ki da u Aron, u kpa jong ki, kumba u Trai u Blei ki Israel U la hukum ïa u.
Na ka bynta kiwei pat ki khun u Lebi, la don u Shubael na ki khun u Amram, u Jehdaia na ki khun u Shubawel.
Na u Rehabia: na ki khun u Rehabia, u Isshia u la long rangbah.
Na ki Ishar, u Shelomoth; na ki khun u Shelomoth, u Jahath.
Ki khun u Hebron: u Jeria u rangbah duh, bud sa u Amaria, u balai u Jahasiel, u basaw u Jekameam.
Ki khun u Ussiel, u Mika; na ki khun u Mika, u Shamir.
U para u Mika, u Isshia: na ki khun u Isshia, u Zekharia.
Ki khun u Merari: u Mahli bad u Mushi. U khun u Jaasia: u Beno.
Ki khun u Merari: na u Jaasia, u Beno, u Shoham, u Zakkur bad u Ibri.
Na u Mahli: u Eleasar ubym don khun shynrang.
Na u Kish, u khun jong u: u Jerahmeel.
Ki khun u Mushi: u Mahli, u Eder, bad u Jerimoth. Kine ki long ki khun u Lebi katkum ki ïing kur.

Kine ruh—u rangbah jong kawei pa kawei ka ïing kur bad u para jong u—ki la khalai kumba la leh ki kur jong ki khun u Aron, hakhmat jong u syiem Dabid, jong u Zadok, jong u Ahimelekh, jong ki rangbah ïing kur lyngdoh bad jong ki ïing kur Lebi.

Na ka bynta ki jinglehniam, u Dabid bad ki rangbah kiba dei peit ïa ki Jinglehniam ki la buh kyrpang ïa ki khun jong u Asaph, jong u Heman bad jong u Jeduthun ban rwai riewblei da ki duitara, ki marynthing bad ki ’singpadiah. Ki kyrteng jong kito kiba dei ban leh ïa kane ka kam ki long:
Na ki khun u Asaph: u Zakkur, u Joseph, u Nethania, bad u Asharela, ki khun u Asaph, hapoh ka jingïalam u Asaph, kiba la rwai riewblei hapoh ka jingpynïaid u syiem.

Na u Jeduthun, ki khun u Jeduthun: u Gedalia, u Zeri, u Jeshaïa, u Shimei, u Hashabia, bad u Mattithia, hynriew ngut, hapoh ka jingpynïaid u kpa jong ki, u Jeduthun, uba la rwai riewblei da ka duitara kum ka jingainguh bad ka jingïaroh ïa u Trai.
Na u Heman, ki khun u Heman: u Bukkia, u Mattania, u Ussiel, u Shebuwel, u Jerimoth, u Hanania, u Hanani, u Eliatha, u Giddalti, u Romamtieser, u Joshbekasha, u Mallothi, u Hothir, u Mahasioth.
Kine baroh ki khun u Heman u men kunok u syiem, kumba u Blei U la kular ban kyntiew ïa u, naba u Blei U la ai ïa u Heman khatsaw ngut ki khun shynrang bad lai ngut ki khun kynthei.

Kine baroh ki dei hapoh ka jingïalam u kpa lajong na ka bynta ka jingrwai ha ïing u Trai da ki ’singpadiah, ki marynthing bad ki duitara haba leh niam ha ïing u Blei. U Asaph, u Jeduthun bad u Heman ki la hap hapoh ka hukum u syiem.
Haba ñiew lang ïa ki bad ïa ki kur baroh kiba la ïoh jinghikai na ka bynta ka jingrwai ha ïing u Trai, baroh kiba la tbit nadong shadong, ki la don arspah phraphew phra ngut.
Kumta ki samla bad ki rangbah, u nonghikai bad u shah hikai, ki la khalai nusib mar kumjuh na ka bynta ki deiti jong ki.
Ha ka jingkhalai banyngkong la ïoh u Joseph na ka ïing kur u Asaph, ha ka ba-ar la ïoh u Gedalia, ma u, ki hynmen para jong u bad ki khun jong u, khat-ar ngut.
Ha ka balai, la ïoh u Zakkur, ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut.
Ha ka basaw la ïoh u Isri, ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut.
Ha ka basan, la ïoh u Nethania, ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut;
ha ka bahynriew la ïoh u Bakkia, ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut;
ha ka bahynñiew la ïoh u Jesarela, ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut;
ha ka baphra la ïoh u Jeshaïa, ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut;
ha ka bakhyndai la ïoh u Mattania, ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut;
ha ka bashiphew la ïoh u Shimei, ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut;
ha ka bakhatwei la ïoh u Azarel, ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut;
ha ka bakhat-ar la ïoh u Hashabia, ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut;
ha ka bakhatlai la ïoh u Shubawel ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut;
ha kaba khatsaw la ïoh u Mattithia, ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut,
ha ka bakhatsan la ïoh u Jeremoth, ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut;
ha ka ba khathynriew u la ïoh u Hanania, ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut;
ha ka bakhathynñiew la ïoh u Joshbekasha, ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut;
ha ka bakhatphra la ïoh u Hanani, ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut;
ha ka bakhatkhyndai la ïoh u Mallothi, ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut;
ha ka ba-arphew la ïoh u Eliatha, ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut;
ha ka ba arphew wei la ïoh u Hothir, ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut;
ha ka ba arphew-ar la ïoh u Giddalti, ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut;
ha ka ba arphew lai la ïoh u Mahasioth, ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut;
ha ka ba arphew saw la ïoh u Romamti-Ezar ki khun bad ki hynmen para jong u, khat-ar ngut.
Shaphang ka jingbate kam ïa ki nongap khyrdop: na ki Gora, u Meshelemia khun u Gore, uwei na ki khun u Asaph.
U Meshelemia u la don ki khun: u Zekharia u banyngkong, bud sa u Jediael, nangta u Zebadia u balai, u Jathniel u basaw,
u Elam u basan, u Jehohanan u bahynriew, u Elioenai u bahynñiew.
U Obed-Edom u la don ki khun: u Shemaïa u baphrangsngi, bud sa u Jehosabad, u Joab u balai, u Sakar u basaw, u Nethanel u basan,
u Ammiel u bahynriew, u Issakhar u bahynñiew, u Peullethia u baphra, naba u Trai U la kyrkhu ïa u.
Na u Shemaïa, u khun jong u, la kha ki khun kiba la long ki rangbah nongïalam ïa ki ïingkur, namar ki la long ki briew ki batbit shibun.
Ki khun u Shemaïa: u Othni, u Rephael, u Obed, bad u Elzabad; ki para jong une, u Elihu bad u Semakhia ki la long ki briew ki batbit.
Kine baroh ki dei ki khun u Obed-Edom. Kine, ki khun jong ki, bad baroh shipara, ki la long ki briew ki batbit ha ka kam shakri. Ki jong u Obed-Edom, hynriewphew ar ngut.
U Meshelemia u la don ki khun bad ki hynmen para, khatphra ngut ki briew ki bashlur.
U Hosa, uwei na ki khun u Merari, u la don ki khun: u Shimri u nongïalam (la um dei u khun phrangsngi, u kpa jong u, u la thung rangbah ïa u),
u Hilkia u babud, u Tebalia u balai, u Zekharia u basaw. Ki khun bad ki hynmen para u Hosa ki la long khatlai ngut.
Kine ki nongap khyrdop ba la bate kam ki la don la ki deiti hapoh la ki jong ki rangbah, thik kum kiwei pat ki kur jong ki, ban shakri ha ka ïing u Trai.
Man ka ïing kur, rit ne khraw kajuh, ka la shu khalai nusib na ka bynta ki khyrdop.
Ka liang mihngi ka la hap ha u Shelemia. Ki la khalai nusib na ka bynta u khun jong u, u Zekharia, u nongsneng nongkraw u basian, bad u la ïoh ïa ka liang ba shatei.
Ha u Obed-Edom la hap ka bashathie, bad ha ki khun jong u la ai bynta ïa ka ïing buh tiar.
U Shuppim bad u Hosa ki la ïoh ïa ka liang sepngi ka khyrdop Shallekheth kaba ha ka lynti kaba kiew shaneng. Kiba dei ban ap phira, ki pynbeit ïa la ki pali jingap.
Shaphang mihngi la don hynriew ngut man la ka sngi, shaphang shatei saw ngut man la ka sngi, shaphang shathie saw ngut man la ka sngi, nangta ar ngut arngut ha ïing buh tiar.
Na ka bynta ka Parbar ba sha sepngi la don saw ngut ha lynti bah bad ar ngut ha ka Parbar.
Kine ki la long ki jingbate kam ïa ki nongap khyrdop hapdeng ki ïing kur Gora bad Merari.
Napdeng ki Lebi, dei u Ahija uba peit ïa ki jynkynshew ka ïing u Blei bad jong ki jyntyrwa niam.
Ki khun u Ladan, kiba ïadei kur bad u Gershon lyngba u Ladan, ki rangbah jong ki ïing kur kiba ïadei bad u Ladan uba shikur bad u Gershon: u Jehieli.
Ki khun u Jehieli, lem bad ki para jong u, u Zetham bad u Joel, ki dei peit ïa ki jynkynshew ha ïing u Trai.
Na ki ïing kur u Amram, u Ishar, u Hebron bad u Ussiel:
u Shebuwel, khun u Gershom, khun u Moses, u la long u rangbah duh ban peit ïa ki Jynkynshew.
Ki kur jong u: na u Elieser, u Rehabia u khun jong u, u Jeshaia u khun jong u, u Joram u khun jong u, u Zikhri u khun jong u, bad u Shelomoth u khun jong u.

Une u Shelomoth bad ki kur jong u ki dei peit ïa ki jynkynshew shaphang ki Jyntyrwa niam, ïa kiba u Dabid syiem, ki rangbah ïing kur, ki rangbah pyrton jong ki hajar bad ki spah, bad ki rangbah duh jong ki pyrton, ki la aiti.
Na ki bai kliarwait ba ïoh na thma, ki la tyrwa ki jynai niam na ka bynta ban kyrshan ïa ka ïing u Trai.
Ïa kiei kiei baroh ba u Samuel u men kunok, u Saul u khun u Kish, u Abner khun u Ner, bad u Joab khun u Zeruïa ki la aiti kyntang kum ki jyntyrwa niam, la phah sumar ha u Shelomoth bad ki kur jong u.
Napdeng ki Ishar, ïa u Khenania bad ki khun jong u la thung ban kit ïa ki kam shnong kam thaw ha Israel kum ki nongthoh bad ki nongbishar.
Na ki Hebron: u Hashabia bad ki kur jong u, shihajar hynñiewspah ngut ki briew ki batbit, ki dei peit ïa ka Israel kaba sha sepngi ka Jordan na ka bynta ki kam u Trai, kum ki shakri u syiem.

Napdeng ki Hebron, u Jerija u la long u rangbah duh ki Hebron kiba na kano kano ka jinghiar pateng ne ka ïing kur. (Ha ka snem ka basawphew jong ka jingsynshar u Dabid la pynlong ka jingwad, bad la shem ba hapdeng jong ki, ki don ki briew ki batbit bha ha Jazer, kaba ha Gilead.)

U Dabid u la thung ïa u bad ïa ki kur jong u, arhajar hynñiewspah ngut ki briew ki batbit, ki rangbah ïing kur, ban peit ïa ki Reuben, ki Gad, bad ka shiteng ka jait Manasse ha ki kam baroh kiba ïadei bad u Blei bad u syiem.

Kane ka long ka Jynthoh kyrteng ïa ki rangbah ïing kur, ïa ki rangbah duh halor ki hajar bad ki spah ngut, bad ïa ki rangbah pynïaid kam kiba shakri ïa u syiem ha ki kam baroh kiba ïadei bad ki kynhun pyrton kiba wan ba leit, man la u bnai baroh shi snem. Kawei kawei ka kynhun pyrton ka don arphew saw hajar ki pyrton.
U Jashobeam u khun u Zabdiel u dei halor ka kynhun banyngkong ha u bnai banyngkong. Ha ka kynhun jong u la don arphew saw hajar ngut.
U dei u khun u ksiew jong u Peres, bad u la long rangbah duh ïa ki rangbah pyrton baroh ha u bnai banyngkong.
U Dodai u nong Aho u dei rangbah ïa ka kynhun ha u bnai ba-ar. Ha ka kynhun jong u la don arphew saw hajar ngut.
U rangbah duh u balai, ha u bnai balai, u la long u Benaïa, khun u Jehoïada lyngdoh. Ha ka kynhun jong u la don arphew saw hajar ngut.
U dei une uta u Benaïa u bakhlaiñ bor hapdeng ki Laiphew ngut, bad uba la long rangbah ïa ki Laiphew ngut. U Ammisabad u khun jong u, u dei halor ka kynhun jong u.
U Asahel, shipara bad u Joab, u la long u basaw, ha u bnai u basaw, bad u khun jong u, u Zebadia u la bud pateng ïa u. Ha ka kynhun jong u la don arphew saw hajar ngut.
U rangbah u basan, ha u bnai u basan, u dei u Shamhuth u nong Isra; ha ka kynhun jong u la don arphew saw hajar ngut.
U bahynriew, ha u bnai bahynñiew, u la long u Ira, u khun u Ikkesh nong Tekoa; ha ka kynhun jong u la don arphew saw hajar ngut.
U bahynñiew, ha u bnai bahynñiew, u la long u Helez nong Pelon, na ka jait Ephraim; ha ka kynhun jong u la don arphew saw hajar ngut.
U baphra, ha u bnai baphra, u dei u Sibbekai nong Hushath, na ka ïing kur u Zera; ha ka kynhun jong u la don arphew saw hajar ngut.
U bakhyndai, ha u bnai u bakhyndai, u la long u Abieser na Anathoth, na ka jait Benjamin; ha ka kynhun jong u la don arphew saw hajar ngut.
U bashiphew, ha u bnai bashiphew, u la long u Maharai na Netopha, na ka ïing kur Zera; ha ka kynhun jong u la don arphew saw hajar ngut.
U bakhatwei, ha u bnai u bakhatwei, u la long u Benaïa na Pirathon, napdeng ki khun u Ephraim; ha ka kynhun jong u la don arphew saw hajar ngut.
U bakhat-ar, ha u bnai u bakhat-ar, u la long u Heldai nong Netophath, na ka ïing kur u Othniel; ha ka kynhun jong u la don arphew saw hajar ngut.
Halor ki jait Israel: na ka bynta ki Reuben, u Elieser khun u Zikhri u la long rangbah; na ka bynta ki Simeon, u Shephatia khun u Maaka.
Na ka bynta ki Lebi, u Hashabia, khun u Kemuwel; na ka bynta u Aron, u Zadok.
Na ka bynta u Juda, u Elihu, uwei na ki hynmen u Dabid; na ka bynta ki Issakhar, u Omri khun u Mikhael.
Na ka bynta ki Zebulun, u Ishmaïa, khun u Obadia; na ka bynta ki Napthtali, u Jeremoth, khun u Asriel;
na ka bynta ki Ephraim, u Hoshea, khun u Asasia; na ka bynta ka shiteng ka jait Manasse, u Joel, khun u Pedaïa.
Na ka bynta ka shiteng ka jait Manasse ha Gilead, u Iddo khun u Zekharia; na ka bynta ki Benjamin, u Jaasiel, khun u Abner;
na ka bynta ki Dan, u Asarel, khun u Jeroham. Kine ki la long ki rangbah kit kam jong ki jait Israel.
U Dabid um shym ñiew ïa kiba duna arphew snem ka ryta, naba u Trai U la kular ban pynroi ïa ki Israel kat ki khlur ka bneng.

U Joab u khun u Zeruïa u la sdang ban ñiew, hynrei khlem pyndep. Pynban la wan hiar ka jingbitar halor ki Israel na ka bynta kane, kumta ïa ka jingñiew ym shym kyntiew ha ki jynthoh kynmaw u syiem Dabid.
Ban peit ïa ki jynkynshew u syiem la don u Asmabeth u khun u Adiel; ïa ki jynkynshew ha ka ri, ha ki shnong, ha ki nongrit bad ki kut, la don u Jonathan, khun u Ussia.
Ban peit ïa kito kiba trei ha ki lyngkha ban puh ïa ka khyndew la don u Esri khun u Khelub;
ban peit ïa ki brisoh waiñ dei u Shimei u nong Ramath; bad ban peit ïa u soh na ki brisoh waiñ na ka bynta ka khrum buh waiñ dei u Zabdi u nong Shiphmi.
Ïa ki dieng olib bad dieng dymbur ha Shephela la don u Baal-Hanan u nong Geder; ban peit ïa ka kudam umphniang dei u Joash.
Ban peit ïa ki kynhun jynri ba bam phlang ha Sharon la don u Shitrai nong Sharon; ïa ki kynhun jynri kiba ha them dei u Shaphat khun u Adlai.
Ban peit ïa ki ut dei u Obli jait Ishmael, ban peit ïa ki kada kynthei la don u Jehdeïa u nong Meronoth. Ban peit ïa ki kynhun langbrot dei u Jasis u nong Hakri.
Kine baroh dei ki nongpeit nongkhmih ïa ka spah ka hajar jong u syiem Dabid.
U Jonathan, u kñi u Dabid, u la long u myntri, namar u long u ’riewshemphang bad u nongthoh. Ma u bad u Jehiel u khun u Hakhmoni ki dei peit ïa ki khun u syiem.
U Ahithophel u la long u myntri u syiem, bad u Hushai nong Arkhi u la long u lok u syiem.
Ïa u Ahithophel la bud pateng da u Jehoïada khun u Benaïa, bad u Abiathar. U Joab u la long u rangbah duh jong ki pyrton u syiem.

Te u Dabid u la lum lang ha Jerusalem ïa ki rangbah kit kam baroh jong ki Israel, ïa ki rangbah kit kam jong ki jait, ïa ki rangbah jong ki kam syiem, ïa ki rangbah jong ki pyrton shihajar, ïa ki rangbah jong ki pyrton shispah, ïa ki nongpeit nongkhmih halor ka spah ka hajar u syiem bad ki khun jong u, ryngkat bad ki rangbah ïing syiem, ki ’riewkhlaiñ bad ki ’riewïaleh baroh kiba la kyr-ïaw.

Hangta u syiem Dabid u la ïeng bad u la ong, “Ko hynmen ko para, ko paidbah jong nga, sngap ngan ong. Nga la don ka jingkwah ban tei ka ïing ka baneh na ka bynta ka synduk jutang u Trai, ka jingïuh kjat jong u Blei jong ngi. Nga la pynkhreh na ka bynta ban tei.
Hynrei u Blei U la ong ha nga, ‘Phin ym tei ka ïing na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong Nga, namar ba phi long u khlawait bad phi la pynphlei snam.’

Pynban u Trai u Blei ki Israel U la jied ïa nga na ka ïing kur jong nga baroh ban long u syiem halor ki Israel junom. U la jied ïa u Juda kum u nongïalam, bad na ka ïing u Juda ïa ka ïing kur jong nga, bad napdeng ki khun u kpa jong nga U la sngewbha ban pynlong ïa nga u syiem halor ki Israel baroh.
Te napdeng ki khun jong nga baroh (naba u Trai U la ai ïa nga bun ki khun shynrang) U la jied ïa u Solomon u khun jong nga ban shong ha ka khet jong ka hima u Trai halor ki Israel.
U la ong ha nga, ‘Dei u Solomon u khun jong phi u ban sa tei ïa ka ïing jong Nga bad ïa ki mynshem jong Nga, naba Nga la jied ïa u ban long u khun jong Nga, bad Ngan sa long u kpa jong u.
Ngan sa pynskhem ïa ka jinglong syiem jong u junom lada u ïaineh skhem ha kaba rakhe ïa ki hukum bad ki aiñ jong Nga kumba u rakhe mynta.’

Te kumta mynta hakhmat jong ki Israel baroh bad jong une u paidbah paidlang u Trai, bad ha ka baïohsngew u Blei jong ngi, to rakhe bad to angnud ïa ki hukum baroh jong u Trai u Blei jong phi. Ha kata ka rukom, phin lah ban ïoh shong duh ha kane ka ri babha, bad phin ieh noh pateng ïa ka ha ki khun ki ksiew jong phi junom nadien jong phi.

“Ma phi pat, ko Solomon ko khun jong nga, to tip ïa u Blei jong u kpa jong phi, to shakri ïa U da ka dohnud baroh bad da ka jingmut kaba aiti lut. Naba u Trai U wad ïa ki dohnud baroh bad U tip ïa kano kano ka jingthmu bad ka jingpyrkhat. Lada phi wad ïa U, phin shem ïa U; hynrei lada phi lyndet ïa U, Un lait ïa phi junom.
Da pyrkhat: u Trai U la jied ïa phi ban tei ïa ka ïing kum ka jaka shongneh jong U. To long u bakhlaiñ, bad to sdang ban trei noh.”

Te nangta u Dabid u la ai ha u Solomon u khun jong u ïa ka saiñdur shaphang ka batsha jong ka tempyl, jong ki ïing jong ka, jong ki ïing Jynkynshew jong ka, jong ki kamra kiba shaneng bad shapoh jong ka, bad jong ka kamra ba don ka khet isynei.

U la ai jingbatai ïa kaba u la don ha ka jingmut shaphang ki phyllaw ïing u Trai, shaphang ki kamra kiba tawiar, shaphang ki ïing Jynkynshew ka ïing u Blei, bad shaphang ki jaka buh ïa ki Jynai kular niam.
Nangta sa ïa ki jingbate kyrdan shaphang ki lyngdoh, ki Lebi bad ki kam shakri niam ha ka ïing u Trai, bad na ka bynta ki khiew ki pliang ba dei leh niam ha ïing u Trai.
U la batai ruh ïa ka jingkhia ka ksiar ha ki khiew ki pliang ksiar kiba dei ïa kawei pa kawei ka jinglehniam, ïa ka jingkhia ki khiew ki pliang rupa kiba dei ïa kawei pa kawei ka jinglehniam,

ïa ka jingkhia ki jynpynïeng sharak ksiar bad ïa ki sharak jong ki, ïa ka jingkhia ka ksiar ha kawei pa kawei ka jynpynïeng sharak bad ha ki sharak jong ka, ïa ka jingkhia ka rupa ha ka jynpynïeng sharak bad ha ki sharak jong ka katkum ka jongpyndonkam ïa kawei pa kawei ka jynpynïeng sharak ha ka jinglehniam,
ïa ka jingkhia ka ksiar ha kawei pa kawei ka miej kaba dei ïa u ’pupyni, ïa ka rupa ha ki miej rupa,
bad ïa ka ksiar nylla ha ki proh, ki dabor, bad ki khuri; shaphang ki dabor ksiar bad ïa ka jingkhia jong kawei pa kawei, shaphang ki dabor rupa bad ïa ka jingkhia jong kawei pa kawei;

shaphang ka duwan Jyniwbih bathaw da ka ksiar ba la saiñ ni, bad ïa ka jingkhia jong ka. U la batai ruh ïa ka saiñdur jong u shaphang ka kali ksiar jong ki kherubim kiba piar thapniang bad kiba kah nalor ïa ka synduk jutang u Trai.
U la pynshai ïa kane baroh ka jyntrei ba dei ban leh da ka jynthoh, katkum ka nuksa kaba u la ïoh na u Trai.

Te u Dabid u la ong ha u Solomon u khun jong u, “To long u bakhlaiñ bad u bashlur, bad to trei noh. Wat tieng wat sngewkhaw-eit, naba u Trai u Blei jong nga, U don bad phi. Un ym lyndet ne ieh noh ïa phi, haduh ban da dep baroh ka jingtrei, na ka bynta ki jinglehniam ha ka ïing u Trai.

La pynbeit shaphang ki jingbate kam ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi na ka bynta ki jinglehniam baroh ha ka ïing u Blei. Kito ki briew baroh kiba kwah ban pynpaw ïa la ka jingnang ha kano kano ka kam shakri kin sa don ryngkat bad phi ha ki jingtrei baroh. Don ruh ki rangbah pynïaid kam bad ki paidbah baroh kiban leh katba phi hukum ïa ki.”

Te u syiem Dabid u la ong ha kata ka jingïalang baroh kawei, “U Solomon u khun jong nga, ba la jied kyrpang da u Blei, u dang khynnah samla bad um pat ïaw jingtip, sa ka jingtrei ruh ka long ka bakhraw bah; naba kane ka ïing dulan kam dei na ka bynta u briew, hynrei na ka bynta u Trai u Blei.

Kumta nga la taïar na ka bynta ka ïing u Blei, katba nga lah, ka ksiar na ka bynta kiei kiei ba donkam ksiar, ka rupa na ka bynta kiei kiei ba donkam rupa, ka rnong na ka bynta kiei kiei ba donkam rnong, u nar na ka bynta kiei kiei ba donkam nar, bad ka dieng na ka bynta kiei kiei ba donkam dieng. Nalor kata, don shikatdei bah ki maw kordor bad ki maw tynsat, ki maw rong bad ki maw thohshuid, baroh ki jait maw kordor bad maw marbyl.

Nalor kine kiba nga taïar lypa na ka bynta ka ïing bakhuid, nga don sa ka jynkynshew ksiar bad rupa la ka jong. Namarba nga sngewieid ïa ka ïing u Blei jong nga, nga ai ïa ka na ka bynta ka ïing u Blei.
Don lai hajar talen ka ksiar kaba na Ophir bad sa hynñiew hajar talen ka rupa ba la saiñ ni ban suit rong ïa ki kynroh ka ïing,

bad na ka bynta ki kam misteri baroh, da ka ksiar haba dei kam ksiar, da ka rupa haba dei kam rupa. Te mano na phi ba la kloi ban ai jyntyrwa sngewbha ha u Trai mynta ka sngi kum ka jingpynkyntang ïa lade?”
Kumta ki rangbah ïing kur, ki rangbah nongïalam jong ki jait, ki rangbah pyrton jong ki hajar bad ki spah, bad ki rangbah kit kam jong u syiem, ki la tyrwa ki jynai sngewbha.
Ki la ai na ka bynta ki jinglehniam ha ïing u Trai ka ksiar san hajar talen bad shiphew hajar darik, ka rupa shiphew hajar talen, ka rnong khatphra hajar talen, bad u nar shispah hajar talen.
Kat kiba don mawkordor ki la ai ïa ki ha ka jynkynshew jong ka ïing u Trai kaba hapoh ka jingsumar u Jehiel uba na ïing kur Gershon.
Ki paidbah ki la shadkmen namarba la ai ïa kine da ka mon sngewbha bad la tyrwa ha u Trai da ka dohnud baroh. U Dabid syiem ruh u la sngewkmen shikatdei eh.
Nangta u Dabid u la ainguh ïa u Trai hakhmat uta u paidbah paidlang baroh da kine ki ktien:— “Long ba la kyrkhu ma Me, a Trai, u Blei u Israel u kpa jong ngi, junom la junom !

Ka jong Me, ko Trai, ka jingkhraw bad ka bor, ka jinglong syiem, ka jingphyrnai bad ka burom ! Baroh katba don ha bneng bad ha khyndew dei ka jong Me; ka jong Me, a Trai, ka long ka hima; Me dei u Bahalor tam eh.
Ka spah bad ka burom ki wan na Me, bad Me synshar halor kiei kiei baroh. Ha ka kti jong Me don ka bor bad ka jingkhlaiñ; dei tang ma Me Uba ai jingkhraw bad jingkhlaiñ ïa kiei kiei baroh.
Namarkata, ko Blei jong ngi, ngi ainguh ïa Me, bad ngi ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw ka kyrteng jong Me.

“Hynrei uei ma nga, bad u long aïu u paid jong nga, ba ngi dei ban don la ka lad ban ai kylluid katne katne ha Me? Kiei kiei baroh ki wan tang na Me bad ngi la ai sha Me ïa kata kaba ngi la ïohpdiang na Me.
Ngi long ki nongwei hakhmat jong Me, bad ki nongshong basa, kumba la long ki kpa tymmen jong ngi. Ki sngi jong ngi ha pyrthei ki long kum ka syrngiew, bad ym don jaka shongneh satia.
A Trai, ko Blei jong ngi, kane ka jynkynshew baroh katne ba ngi la taïar ban tei ïa ka ïing na ka bynta ka kyrteng bakhuid jong Me, ka wan na ka kti jong Me bad ka long baroh ka jong Me.

Nga tip, ko Blei jong nga, ba Me ju tynjuh ïa ki dohnud bad ba Me sngewbha ïa ka jingleh hok. Da ka dohnud kaba wad ban leh hok nga la tyrwa ïa kine kiei kiei baroh da ka mynsiem ka bakylluid, bad nga ïohi mynta ba ki paid jong Me kiba don hangne, ki la ai da ka mynsiem ka bakylluid bad da ka jingkmen.

Ko Trai, ko Blei jong u Abraham, jong u Isaak, bad jong u Israel, ki kpa tymmen jong ngi, to pynneh junom ïa ki jingthmu bad ki jingpyrkhat kiba kum kine ha ki dohnud jong u paid jong Me, bad to ïalam ïa ki dohnud jong ki sha Me.

To ai ha u Solomon u khun jong nga ka jingkwah naduh ka dohnud baroh ban rakhe ïa ki hukum jong Me, ïa ki riti niam bad ki aiñ jong Me, ba un dup pyndep ïa ki baroh bad un dup tei ïa ka ïingdulan kaba nga la pynkhreh lypa.”

Nangta u Dabid u la kyrpad ïa uta u paidbah paidlang baroh, “To kyrkhu mynta ïa u Trai, u Blei jong phi.” Kumta uta u paid baroh u la kyrkhu ïa u Trai, u Blei ki kpa tymmen, u la nguh ïa la ka khlieh bad u la mane ïa u Trai, bad u la ainguh aidem ïa u syiem.

Hadien kata u la tyrwa ka kñia ka khriam ha u Trai. Ynda kum lashai pat u la tyrwa ki jynkñia thang ha u Trai shihajar tylli ki masi, shihajar tylli ki blang, bad shihajar tylli ki langbrot, lem bad ki jyntyrwa ban suit ban shor bad kiwei kiwei ki jynkñia na ka bynta ki Israel baroh.

Ha kata ka sngi ki la bam la dih hakhmat u Trai da ka jingkmen ka bakhraw. Sa shisien ki la pynbna syiem ïa u Solomon u khun u Dabid, bad ki la pynsleh ïa u kum u nongïalam u Trai, bad ïa u Zadok kum u lyngdoh.
Nangta u Solomon u la mih bteng halor ka khet jong u Trai kum u syiem ha ka jaka u Dabid u kpa jong u. U la manbha, bad ki Israel baroh ki la kohnguh ïa u.
Baroh ki nongïalam bad ki ’riewkhlaiñ, wat ki khun u syiem Dabid baroh, ki la smai ban kohnguh ïa u syiem Solomon.
U Trai U la ai ka nam ka bakhraw ïa u Solomon hakhmat ki Israel baroh, bad U la pynkup ïa u da ka jinglong syiem man syiem ka baphyrnai. Ym pat ju don syiem Israel mynshuwa uba la ïoh kat kata.
U Dabid, u khun u Jesse, u la synshar halor ki Israel baroh.
Ka jingsynshar jong u ka la neh sawphew snem; hynñiew snem ha Hebron, bad laiphew lai snem ha Jerusalem.
U la ïap ynda u la tymmen bha, haba u la pura bha ki sngi, ka spah bad ka burom; bad u Solomon, u khun jong u, u la mih bteng ïa u.
Ïa ki kam u syiem Dabid, naduh basdang haduh bakut, la thoh ha ki kot Jynthoh kynmaw u Samuel kunok, ha ki Jynthoh kynmaw u Nathan nongïathuh lypa, bad ha ki Jynthoh kynmaw u Gad kunok,
lem bad ka jingïathuh khana ïa ka jingsynshar jong u, ïa ka jingdonbor jong u, bad ïa ki jingjia kiba la wanhap wanlong ha u, ha ki Israel bad ha ki hima baroh jong kiwei pat ki ri.
